steps.contentHtml:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Solar System Adventure - Book Briefing</title>
  <style>
    *{
      margin:0;
      padding:0;
      box-sizing:border-box;
    }
    body{
      font-family:'Comic Sans MS','Comic Neue',system-ui,sans-serif;
      background:#0f0c29;
      color:#e0e7ff;
      min-height:100vh;
      position:relative;
      overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    .stars{
      position:fixed;
      top:0;
      left:0;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      pointer-events:none;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 40px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 40px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 130px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 160px 120px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 200px 50px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 250px 160px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 650px 190px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 800px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 850px 170px,#fff,transparent);
      background-size:900px 200px;
      animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index:0;
    }
    @keyframes twinkle{
      0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}
      50%{opacity:0.8;}
    }
    .container{
      max-width:640px;
      margin:auto;
      padding:32px 16px 40px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .cover{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea 0%,#764ba2 100%);
      border-radius:28px;
      padding:40px 28px;
      text-align:center;
      color:#fff;
      box-shadow:0 10px 40px rgba(102,126,234,0.4);
      margin-bottom:22px;
      position:relative;
      overflow:hidden;
      flex-shrink:0;
    }
    .cover::before{
      content:'';
      position:absolute;
      top:-50%;
      left:-50%;
      width:200%;
      height:200%;
      background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,0.1) 0%,transparent 70%);
      animation:rotate 20s linear infinite;
    }
    @keyframes rotate{
      from{transform:rotate(0deg);}
      to{transform:rotate(360deg);}
    }
    .cover .logo{
      font-size:70px;
      line-height:1;
      margin-bottom:12px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .cover h1{
      font-size:34px;
      margin-bottom:8px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .cover .tagline{
      font-size:18px;
      opacity:.95;
      margin-bottom:18px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .cover .badges{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:10px;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    .cover .pill{
      background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);
      padding:8px 16px;
      border-radius:999px;
      font-size:14px;
      font-weight:bold;
    }
    .card{
      background:#1a1735;
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border-radius:24px;
      padding:22px;
      margin-bottom:18px;
      box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
    }
    .card h2{
      color:#a78bfa;
      margin-bottom:14px;
      font-size:22px;
    }
    .card p{
      font-size:18px;
      line-height:1.8;
      margin-bottom:12px;
    }
    .meta-row{
      display:flex;
      gap:14px;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
      margin-bottom:8px;
    }
    .meta-item{
      flex:1;
      min-width:140px;
      background:rgba(167,139,250,0.2);
      border-radius:16px;
      padding:14px;
      text-align:center;
    }
    .meta-label{
      font-size:13px;
      font-weight:bold;
      color:#c4b5fd;
      margin-bottom:4px;
    }
    .meta-value{
      font-size:18px;
      font-weight:bold;
      color:#fff;
    }
    .concept-grid{
      display:grid;
      grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
      gap:12px;
      margin-top:6px;
    }
    .concept-item{
      background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
      border-radius:14px;
      padding:12px 14px;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:10px;
      font-size:15px;
      font-weight:bold;
      color:#e0e7ff;
    }
    .concept-item .emoji{
      font-size:22px;
    }
    .steps{
      counter-reset: step;
    }
    .step{
      display:flex;
      gap:14px;
      margin-bottom:16px;
      align-items:flex-start;
    }
    .step-num{
      flex-shrink:0;
      width:34px;
      height:34px;
      border-radius:50%;
      background:#667eea;
      color:#fff;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      font-weight:bold;
    }
    .step p{
      margin:0;
      font-size:17px;
      line-height:1.7;
    }
    .tip{
      margin-top:0;
      background:rgba(251,191,36,0.2);
      border-left:6px solid #fbbf24;
      padding:16px;
      border-radius:12px;
      font-size:17px;
      line-height:1.7;
    }
    .nav-hint{
      margin-top:20px;
      text-align:center;
      font-size:13px;
      color:#a78bfa;
      background:rgba(167,139,250,0.1);
      padding:10px;
      border-radius:10px;
    }
    .start-btn{
      display:block;
      width:100%;
      text-align:center;
      margin-top:6px;
      padding:20px;
      border:none;
      border-radius:18px;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#667eea,#764ba2);
      color:white;
      font-size:22px;
      font-weight:bold;
      cursor:pointer;
      text-decoration:none;
      transition:.2s;
    }
    .start-btn:active{
      transform:scale(.98);
    }
    .author-row{
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      gap:14px;
    }
    .author-avatar{
      flex-shrink:0;
      width:56px;
      height:56px;
      border-radius:50%;
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a78bfa,#667eea);
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      font-size:28px;
    }
    .author-name{
      font-size:19px;
      font-weight:bold;
      color:#fff;
    }
    .author-role{
      font-size:14px;
      color:#c4b5fd;
    }
    .speech{
      background:rgba(251,191,36,0.15);
      border-radius:16px;
      padding:18px;
      margin-top:12px;
      position:relative;
    }
    .speech::before{
      content:'💬';
      position:absolute;
      top:-12px;
      left:20px;
      font-size:24px;
    }
    .speech p{
      font-size:17px;
      line-height:1.7;
      font-style:italic;
      margin:0;
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container{padding:20px 14px 32px;}
      .cover{padding:28px 20px;}
      .cover .logo{font-size:56px;margin-bottom:10px;}
      .cover h1{font-size:26px;}
      .cover .tagline{font-size:15px;margin-bottom:14px;}
      .cover .pill{font-size:12px;padding:6px 12px;}
    }
  /* solar-desktop-fit */
html {
  min-height: 100%;
}
body:has(.character-grid),
body:has(.game-shell),
body:has(#solarSvg),
body:has(.fire-btn),
body:has(.planet-game) {
  overflow: hidden !important;
  height: 100%;
  min-height: 0 !important;
}
body:not(:has(.character-grid)):not(:has(.game-shell)):not(:has(#solarSvg)):not(:has(.fire-btn)):not(:has(.planet-game)) {
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: auto;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  min-height: 100%;
  height: auto;
}
.game-shell {
  height: 100%;
  max-height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
body:has(.character-grid) .container,
body:has(.game-shell) .container,
body:has(#solarSvg) .container,
body:has(.fire-btn) .container,
body:has(.planet-game) .container {
  height: 100%;
  max-height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  overflow: hidden;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}
body:has(.game-shell) .game-shell {
  padding: 4px 8px 6px;
}
body:has(.game-shell) .game-shell .title {
  display: none;
}
body:has(.game-shell) .ui-container {
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  padding: 4px 8px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
body:has(.game-shell) .game-stage {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0 !important;
  height: auto !important;
  max-height: none !important;
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: 7 / 6;
}
body:has(.game-shell) .touch-controls {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
body:has(#solarSvg) .container {
  padding: 8px 12px 10px;
}
body:has(#solarSvg) .solar-panel {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  margin-bottom: 6px;
  padding: 8px;
}
body:has(#solarSvg) .svg-wrap {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0;
  max-height: none;
  aspect-ratio: unset;
  height: auto;
}
body:has(#solarSvg) #solarSvg {
  min-height: 0;
  height: 100%;
}
body:has(#solarSvg) .minigame-panel {
  flex-shrink: 0;
  max-height: 34%;
  overflow-y: auto;
}
body:has(.fire-btn) .container {
  padding: 4px 12px 6px;
}
body:has(.fire-btn) .game-wrap {
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  min-height: 0 !important;
  height: auto !important;
  max-height: none !important;
}
body:has(.fire-btn) .fire-btn {
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
body:has(.character-grid) .container {
  padding: 8px 12px 10px;
  justify-content: center;
}
body:has(.character-grid) .header {
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
body:has(.character-grid) .preview-section {
  padding: 8px;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
body:has(.character-grid) .preview-character {
  font-size: 36px;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
}
body:has(.character-grid) input[type="text"] {
  margin-bottom: 8px;

}
body:has(.character-grid) .character-grid {
  gap: 6px;
  margin-bottom: 0;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
body:has(.character-grid) .character-option {
  padding: 6px 2px;
  font-size: 26px;
  border-width: 2px;
  border-radius: 12px;
}
body:has(.character-grid) .character-name {
  font-size: 10px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
@media (min-width: 640px), (min-width: 768px) and (max-width: 1024px) {
  body:has(.character-grid) .container {
    padding: 6px 12px 8px;
    justify-content: center;
  }
  body:has(.character-grid) h1 {

  }
  body:has(.character-grid) .header {
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  body:has(.character-grid) .subtitle {
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  body:has(.character-grid) .preview-section {
    padding: 6px 8px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;

  }
  body:has(.character-grid) .preview-character {
    font-size: 32px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }
  body:has(.character-grid) .preview-name {
    font-size: 15px;
  }
  body:has(.character-grid) input[type="text"] {
    padding: 6px 10px;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    font-size: 14px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  body:has(.character-grid) .character-grid {
    gap: 6px;

  }
  body:has(.character-grid) .character-option {
    padding: 4px 2px;

  body:has(.game-shell) .ui-item {

  }

  }
  body:has(#solarSvg) .header {
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  body:has(#solarSvg) h1 {
    font-size: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  body:has(#solarSvg) .subtitle {
    font-size: 13px;
  }
  body:has(#solarSvg) .info-panel,
  body:has(#solarSvg) .nav-hint {
    display: none;
  }
  body:has(.fire-btn) .header {
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  body:has(.fire-btn) .header h1 {
    font-size: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
  }
  body:has(.fire-btn) .header .subtitle {
    display: none;
  }
  body:has(.fire-btn) .hud {
    padding: 6px 10px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
    font-size: 12px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  body:has(.fire-btn) .game-wrap {
    margin-bottom: 4px;
  }
  body:has(.fire-btn) .fire-btn {
    padding: 10px;
    font-size: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }
  body:has(.fire-btn) .instructions,
  body:has(.fire-btn) .nav-hint {
    display: none;
  }
  .planet-svg-panel .svg-viewport,
  .svg-viewport {
    max-height: 220px !important;
    min-height: 0 !important;
  }
  .planet-game .game-canvas,
  .game-canvas-wrap {
    height: 220px !important;
    min-height: 180px !important;
    max-height: 220px !important;
  }
  .planet-game {
    padding: 10px;
    margin-top: 10px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }
  .planet-game h2 {
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    font-size: 17px;
  }
  .planet-game p {
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    font-size: 12px;
  }
  .touch-controls {
    margin-top: 6px;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 48px);
    grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 48px);
    gap: 6px;
  }
  .touch-btn {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    font-size: 18px;
  }
}
@media (max-height: 760px) {
  body:has(.character-grid) .preview-character {
    font-size: 28px;
  }
  body:has(.character-grid) .character-option {
    font-size: 22px;
    padding: 3px 2px;
  }
  body:has(.game-shell) .touch-btn {
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    font-size: 18px;
  }
  body:has(.fire-btn) .header h1 {
    font-size: 18px;
  }
}
  
body.reading-page {
  overflow-x: hidden;
  overflow-y: auto !important;
  height: auto !important;
  min-height: 100%;
  -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
}
body.reading-page .container {
  height: auto !important;
  max-height: none !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
  display: block;
}

/* solar-ui-audit-overrides */
body.reading-page,
body.reading-page:has(.container),
body.reading-page:has(.quiz-card),
body.reading-page:has(.character-grid) {
  overflow-y: auto !important;
  height: auto !important;
}
body.reading-page .container {
  height: auto !important;
  max-height: none !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
  display: block;
}
body.reading-page:has(.character-grid) .container {
  height: auto !important;
  max-height: none !important;
  overflow: visible !important;
  justify-content: flex-start;
}
@media (max-width: 639px) {
  body.big-planet-page .planet-svg-panel {
    padding: 8px !important;
    margin-left: 0 !important;
    margin-right: 0 !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    overflow: hidden !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
  }
  body.big-planet-page .svg-viewport,
  body.big-planet-page:has(.planet-svg-panel) .svg-viewport {
    width: 100% !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
    height: auto !important;
    max-height: min(78vw, calc(100svh - 220px)) !important;
    min-height: 0 !important;
    aspect-ratio: 1 !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
  }
  body.big-planet-page .container {
    overflow-x: hidden !important;
    max-width: 100% !important;
  }
  body.big-planet-page .sun-game .game-canvas-wrap,
  body.big-planet-page .planet-game .game-canvas,
  body.big-planet-page .planet-game .game-canvas-wrap {
    height: min(48vh, 400px) !important;
    min-height: min(40vh, 280px) !important;
    max-height: min(52vh, 420px) !important;
  }
}
@media (min-width: 640px) {
  body.big-planet-page:has(.planet-svg-panel) .svg-viewport,
  body.big-planet-page .svg-viewport {
    max-height: min(92vw, calc(100svh - 156px)) !important;
    min-height: min(56vw, calc(100svh - 200px)) !important;
  }
}
body.big-planet-page .sun-game .game-canvas-wrap,
body.big-planet-page .planet-game .game-canvas,
body.big-planet-page .planet-game .game-canvas-wrap {
  width: 100% !important;
  height: min(50vh, 440px) !important;
  min-height: min(42vh, 300px) !important;
  max-height: min(56vh, 480px) !important;
}
body.big-planet-page .sun-game,
body.big-planet-page .planet-game {
  margin-bottom: 8px !important;
}
body.big-planet-page .nav-hint {
  margin-top: 8px !important;
  padding-bottom: 8px !important;
  font-size: 12px !important;
  line-height: 1.45 !important;
}
body.all-planets-page:has(#solarSvg) .svg-wrap {
  max-height: min(96vw, calc(100svh - 162px)) !important;
  min-height: min(43svh, calc(100svh - 168px), 96vw) !important;
}
body.big-game-page:has(.game-shell) {
  overflow: hidden !important;
  height: 100% !important;
  min-height: 100% !important;
  max-height: 100% !important;

  height: 100% !important;
  min-height: 100% !important;

  height: 100% !important;

  min-height: 0 !important;
  align-items: center !important;
  justify-content: center !important;

  flex: 1 1 auto !important;
  width: 100% !important;

    align-items: center !important;
    justify-content: center !important;
  }
  body.big-game-page:has(.game-shell) .game-stage {
    flex: 1 1 auto !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    height: 100% !important;
    min-height: 0 !important;
    max-height: none !important;
    aspect-ratio: unset !important;

  max-height: none !important;
}
@media (min-width: 640px) {
  body:has(.planet-svg-panel) .svg-viewport,
  body:has(.planet-game) .game-canvas,
  body:has(.sun-game) .game-canvas-wrap {
    max-height: none !important;
  }
  body.big-planet-page:has(.planet-svg-panel) .svg-viewport {
    max-height: min(92vw, calc(100svh - 156px)) !important;
  }
}
  </style>
<script>
(function (w) {
  var BOOK = "solarsystem";
  function key(name) {
    return "book:" + BOOK + ":" + name;
  }
  w.SolarPlayer = {
    getUserName: function () {
      return localStorage.getItem(key("userName")) || localStorage.getItem("userName") || "Explorer";
    },
    getCharacter: function () {
      return localStorage.getItem(key("userCharacter")) || localStorage.getItem("userCharacter") || "👨‍🚀";
    },
    getCharacterName: function () {
      return localStorage.getItem(key("characterName")) || localStorage.getItem("characterName") || "Astronaut";
    },
    save: function (name, character, characterName) {
      localStorage.setItem(key("userName"), name);
      localStorage.setItem(key("userCharacter"), character);
      if (characterName != null) localStorage.setItem(key("characterName"), characterName);
      localStorage.setItem("userName", name);
      localStorage.setItem("userCharacter", character);
      if (characterName != null) localStorage.setItem("characterName", characterName);
    },
  };
})(window);
</script>
</head>
<body class="reading-page">
<div class="stars"></div>
<div class="container">
  <div class="cover">
    <div class="logo">🌌</div>
    <h1>Solar System Adventure</h1>
    <div class="tagline">Explore space, one planet at a time!</div>
    <div class="badges">

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Solar System Adventure - The Sun Quiz</title>
  <style>
    *{
      margin:0;
      padding:0;
      box-sizing:border-box;
    }
    body{
      font-family:'Comic Sans MS','Comic Neue',system-ui,sans-serif;
      background:#0f0c29;
      color:#e0e7ff;
      min-height:100vh;
      position:relative;
      overflow-x:hidden;
    }
    .stars{
      position:fixed;
      top:0;
      left:0;
      width:100%;
      height:100%;
      pointer-events:none;
      background-image:
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 40px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 90px 40px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 130px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 160px 120px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 200px 50px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 250px 160px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 650px 190px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 800px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 850px 170px,#fff,transparent);
      background-size:900px 200px;
      animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index:0;
    }
    @keyframes twinkle{
      0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}
      50%{opacity:0.8;}
    }
    .container{
      max-width:640px;
      margin:auto;
      padding:12px 16px 20px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container {
        padding: 10px 12px 16px;
      }
    }
    .header{
      text-align:center;
      margin-bottom:12px;
    }
    h1{
      font-size:24px;
      color:#ffd700;
      margin-bottom:4px;
    }
    .subtitle{
      color:#c4b5fd;
      font-size:16px;
    }
    .player-info{
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      gap:8px;
      margin-top:6px;
      font-size:16px;
      color:#ffd700;
      font-weight:bold;
    }
    .player-info span:first-child{
      font-size:24px;
    }
    .competition-bar{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:space-between;
      align-items:center;
      background:#1a1735;
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:10px;
      margin-bottom:12px;
    }
    .competition-bar.hidden{display:none;}
    .competitor{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      align-items:center;
      gap:4px;
    }
    .competitor-icon{font-size:28px;}
    .competitor-name{font-size:12px;color:#c4b5fd;}
    .competitor-score{font-size:18px;font-weight:bold;color:#ffd700;}
    .vs-divider{font-size:18px;color:#a78bfa;font-weight:bold;}
    .quiz-card{
      background:#1a1735;
      backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:12px;
      margin-bottom:8px;
      border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
      display:none;
    }
    .quiz-card.active{
      display:block;
    }
    .question{
      font-size:15px;
      font-weight:bold;
      margin-bottom:10px;
      color:#fff;
    }
    .options{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      gap:6px;
    }
    .option{
      padding:10px 14px;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
      border:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      border-radius:8px;
      cursor:pointer;
      font-size:14px;
      transition:0.2s;
    }
    .option:hover{
      background:#1a1735;
      border-color:#ffd700;
    }
    .option.correct{
      background:rgba(34,197,94,0.3);
      border-color:#22c55e;
    }
    .option.wrong{
      background:rgba(239,68,68,0.3);
      border-color:#ef4444;
    }
    .feedback{
      margin-top:8px;
      padding:8px;
      border-radius:8px;
      font-size:13px;
      display:none;
    }
    .feedback.show{
      display:block;
    }
    .feedback.correct{
      background:rgba(34,197,94,0.2);
      color:#4ade80;
    }
    .feedback.wrong{
      background:rgba(239,68,68,0.2);
      color:#f87171;
    }
    .score-card{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,215,0,0.98), rgba(255,165,0,0.98));
      border-radius:24px;
      padding:10px 20px 60px;
      text-align:center;
      margin-top:20px;
      display:none;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.35);
      border:4px solid #fff176;
      z-index: 10;
      position: relative;
    }
    .score-card.show{
      display:block;
      animation: slideUp 0.5s ease-out;
    }
    @keyframes slideUp {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(30px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }
    .score-card h2{
      font-size:26px;
      margin-top: 0;
      margin-bottom:30px;
      color:#1a1240;
      text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    }
    .score-display{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1240, #3a2f70);
      border-radius:18px;
      padding:18px;
      margin-bottom:18px;
      box-shadow: inset 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 20;
    }
    .score-card .score{
      font-size:52px;
      font-weight:bold;
      margin-bottom:6px;
      color:#ffe066;
      text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255, 224, 102, 0.7);
    }
    .score-label{
      font-size:13px;
      color:#d1c4ff;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing:2px;
    }
    .score-card .message{
      font-size:17px;
      margin-top:10px;
      margin-bottom:16px;
      color:#ffffff;
      font-weight:bold;
      padding:10px;
      background:#1a1240;
      border-radius:12px;
    }
    .podium{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:center;
      align-items:flex-end;
      gap:14px;
      margin-top:120px;
      height:140px;
      padding:6px;
      overflow: visible;
    }
    .podium-place{
      display:flex;
      flex-direction:column;
      align-items:center;
      gap:4px;
      transition:transform 0.3s ease;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .podium-place:hover{
      transform:translateY(-1px);
    }
    .podium-character{
      font-size:42px;
      filter:drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.3));
      animation: none;
    }
    .podium-bar{
      border-radius:12px 12px 0 0;
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;
      font-size:22px;
      font-weight:bold;
      color:#fff;
      position:relative;
      box-shadow: 0 -4px 18px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    }
    .podium-bar.first{
      width:100px;
      height:100px;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b8860b,#8b6914);
      box-shadow: 0 -4px 20px rgba(184,134,11,0.45);
    }
    .podium-bar.second{
      width:90px;
      height:80px;
      background:linear-gradient(180deg,#c0c0c0,#a0a0a0);
      box-shadow: 0 -4px 18px rgba(192,192,192,0.35);
    }
    .rank-badge{
      position:absolute;
      top:-10px;
      font-size:26px;
      animation: none;
    }
    .podium-name{
      font-size:13px;
      color:#1a1240;
      margin-top:6px;
      text-align:center;
      font-weight:bold;
      background:rgba(255,255,255,0.6);
      padding:5px 9px;
      border-radius:8px;
    }
    .podium-score{
      font-size:15px;
      color:#ffffff;
      font-weight:bold;
      background:#1a1240;
      padding:3px 7px;
      border-radius:6px;
    }
    .button-group{
      display:flex;
      gap:10px;
      justify-content:center;
      margin-top:20px;
      flex-wrap:wrap;
    }
    .retry-btn{
      padding:14px 28px;
      border:none;
      border-radius:14px;
      font-size:15px;
      font-weight:bold;
      cursor:pointer;
      transition:all 0.3s ease;
      box-shadow:0 5px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
    }
    .retry-btn{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1a1240,#3a2f70);
      color:#ffe066;
    }
    .retry-btn:hover{
      transform:scale(1.06);
      box-shadow:0 7px 22px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);
    }
    
    
    /* Mobile adjustments */
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .score-card {
        padding:10px 14px 60px;
        margin-top: 14px;
      }
      .score-card h2 {
        font-size: 20px;
      }
      .score-card .score {
        font-size: 10px;
      }
      .score-display {
        padding: 9px;
      }
      .score-card .message {
        margin-top: 8px;
        margin-bottom: 12px;
        font-size: 14px;
        color:#ffffff;
        background:#1a1240;
      }
      .podium {
        height: 120px;
        gap: 12px;
        padding: 6px;
        margin-top: 120px;
      }
      .podium-character {
        font-size: 36px;
      }
      .podium-bar.first {
        width: 85px;
        height: 90px;
        background:linear-gradient(180deg,#b8860b,#8b6914);
      }
      .podium-bar.second {
        width: 75px;
        height: 70px;
      }
      .rank-badge {
        font-size: 22px;
        top: -8px;
      }
      .button-group {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 10px;
      }
      .retry-btn {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 14px;
        font-size: 14px;
      }
    }
    .nav-hint{
      margin-top:12px;
      text-align:center;
      font-size:11px;
      color:#a78bfa;
      background:rgba(167,139,250,0.1);
      padding:6px;
      border-radius:8px;

<body class="reading-page">
<div class="stars"></div>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>❓ The Sun Quiz</h1>
  </div>

  <div class="competition-bar" id="liveScoreBar">
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="playerIcon">👨‍🚀</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="playerName2">Explorer</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="playerScore">0</div>
    </div>
    <div class="vs-divider">VS</div>
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="botIcon">☀️</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="botName">Solaris</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="computerScore">0</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card active" id="quizCard-1">
    <div class="question">1. What is the Sun made of mostly?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Rock and metal</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, true)">Hydrogen and helium</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Oxygen and carbon</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Water and ice</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-1"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-2">
    <div class="question">2. How hot is the Sun's surface?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">1,000°C</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">2,500°C</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, true)">5,500°C</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">10,000°C</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-2"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-3">
    <div class="question">3. What process creates energy in the Sun?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Burning</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, true)">Nuclear fusion</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Electricity</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Chemical reaction</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-3"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-4">
    <div class="question">4. How old is the Sun?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">1 million years</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">100 million years</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">1 billion years</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, true)">4.6 billion years</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-5">
    <div class="question">5. What are dark spots on the Sun called?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, true)">Sunspots</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Moon spots</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Star spots</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Dark holes</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-5"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-6">
    <div class="question">6. How long does it take for sunlight to reach Earth?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, false)">1 second</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, false)">1 minute</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, true)">8 minutes</div>

    <h2>🎉 Quiz Complete!</h2>
    <div class="podium" id="podium">
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-second">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-2">☀️</div>
        <div class="podium-bar second">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥈</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-2">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-2">Solaris</div>
      </div>
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-first">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-1">👨‍🚀</div>
        <div class="podium-bar first">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥇</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-1">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-1">Ariel</div>
      </div>
    </div>

      <button class="retry-btn" onclick="retryQuiz()">🔄 Try Again</button>
    </div>
  </div>

<div class="nav-hint">
  <div>💡 Use the ← → arrows in the top navigation bar to go to the next chapter.</div>
  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 6;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'Solaris';
  const botCharacter = '☀️';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>

<script>
const mercuryFacts = [
  "Mercury is named after the Roman messenger god!",
  "Mercury has no moons!",
  "Mercury has no rings!",
  "Mercury is the fastest planet - it orbits the Sun in just 88 days!",
  "Mercury has ice in craters that never see sunlight!",
  "Mercury's gravity is much weaker than Earth's!",
  "You would weigh much less on Mercury!",
  "Mercury has a huge crater called Caloris Basin!"
];


// Meteor Dodge Game - Canvas-based
let gameScore = 0;
let gameTime = 30;
let gameLives = 3;
let gameInterval;
let spawnInterval;
let animationFrame;
let isGameRunning = false;
let canvas, ctx;
let player;
let meteors = [];
let keys = {};
let moveLeft = false;
let moveRight = false;

function startGame() {
  if (isGameRunning) return;
  const _ss = document.getElementById('startScreen'); if (_ss) _ss.style.display = 'none';
  const _es = document.getElementById('endScreen'); if (_es) _es.style.display = 'none';
  
  canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvasElement');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  
  // Set canvas size
  const canvasContainer = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  canvas.width = canvasContainer.clientWidth;
  canvas.height = canvasContainer.clientHeight;
  
  isGameRunning = true;
  gameScore = 0;
  gameTime = 30;
  gameLives = 3;
  meteors = [];
  
  // Initialize player
  player = {
    x: canvas.width / 2,
    y: canvas.height - 50,
    width: 40,
    height: 40,
    speed: 5
  };
  
  document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Score: 0';
  document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = 'Time: 30s';
  document.getElementById('gameLives').textContent = '❤️'.repeat(gameLives);
  
  // Enable controls
  document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  document.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
  
  // Touch controls
  const leftBtn = document.getElementById('leftBtn');
  const rightBtn = document.getElementById('rightBtn');
  
  leftBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveLeft = true; });
  leftBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveLeft = false; });
  rightBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveRight = true; });
  rightBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveRight = false; });
  
  leftBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => moveLeft = true);
  leftBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => moveLeft = false);
  rightBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => moveRight = true);
  rightBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => moveRight = false);
  
  // Spawn meteors
  spawnInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (!isGameRunning) return;
    spawnMeteor();
  }, 800);
  
  // Game timer
  gameInterval = setInterval(() => {
    gameTime--;
    document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = 'Time: ' + gameTime + 's';
    
    if (gameTime <= 0) {
      endGame();
    }
  }, 1000);
  
  // Start game loop
  gameLoop();
}

function handleKeyDown(e) {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') {
    keys.left = true;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') {
    keys.right = true;
  }
  
  // Prevent scrolling
  if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown'].includes(e.key)) {
    e.preventDefault();
  }
}

function handleKeyUp(e) {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') {
    keys.left = false;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') {
    keys.right = false;
  }
}

function spawnMeteor() {
  const size = Math.random() * 20 + 15;
  meteors.push({
    x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
    y: -size,
    width: size,
    height: size,
    speed: Math.random() * 3 + 2,
    rotation: 0,
    rotationSpeed: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.1
  });
}

function drawEmojiSprite(emoji, x, y, sizePx) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
  ctx.font = sizePx + 'px "Segoe UI Emoji","Apple Color Emoji","Noto Color Emoji",sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffffff';
  ctx.fillText(emoji, x, y);
  ctx.restore();
}

function gameLoop() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  
  // Clear canvas
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,canvas.height);
  bg.addColorStop(0,'#0a0818'); bg.addColorStop(1,'#1a1530');
  ctx.fillStyle = bg;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

  // Draw stars background
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
  for (let i = 0; i < 20; i++) {
    const x = (Math.sin(Date.now() / 1000 + i) * 0.5 + 0.5) * canvas.width;
    const y = (Math.cos(Date.now() / 1000 + i * 2) * 0.5 + 0.5) * canvas.height;
    ctx.fillRect(x, y, 2, 2);
  }
  
  // Update player position
  if (keys.left || moveLeft) {
    player.x -= player.speed;
  }
  if (keys.right || moveRight) {
    player.x += player.speed;
  }
  
  // Keep player in bounds
  player.x = Math.max(player.width / 2, Math.min(canvas.width - player.width / 2, player.x));
  
  // Draw player
  drawEmojiSprite('🚀', player.x, player.y, player.width);
  
  // Update and draw meteors
  meteors.forEach((meteor, index) => {
    meteor.y += meteor.speed;
    meteor.rotation += meteor.rotationSpeed;
    
    drawEmojiSprite('☄️', meteor.x + meteor.width / 2, meteor.y + meteor.height / 2, meteor.width);

    // Check collision
    if (isColliding(player, meteor)) {
      meteors.splice(index, 1);
      gameLives--;
      document.getElementById('gameLives').textContent = '❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, gameLives)) + '🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - gameLives));
      if (gameLives <= 0) {
        endGame();
        return;
      }
    }
    
    // Remove if off screen
    if (meteor.y > canvas.height + meteor.height) {
      meteors.splice(index, 1);
      gameScore += 10;
      document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Score: ' + gameScore;
    }
  });
  
  animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function isColliding(player, meteor) {
  const playerLeft = player.x - player.width / 2;
  const playerRight = player.x + player.width / 2;
  const playerTop = player.y - player.height / 2;
  const playerBottom = player.y + player.height / 2;
  
  const meteorLeft = meteor.x;
  const meteorRight = meteor.x + meteor.width;
  const meteorTop = meteor.y;
  const meteorBottom = meteor.y + meteor.height;
  
  return !(playerRight < meteorLeft || 
           playerLeft > meteorRight || 
           playerBottom < meteorTop || 
           playerTop > meteorBottom);
}

function endGame() {
  isGameRunning = false;
  clearInterval(gameInterval);
  clearInterval(spawnInterval);
  cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);

  document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);

  const endScreen = document.getElementById('endScreen');
  const endTitle = document.getElementById('endTitle');
  const endStats = document.getElementById('endStats');
  if (gameTime <= 0) {
    endTitle.textContent = '🎉 You Survived!';
    endStats.textContent = 'Final score: ' + gameScore;
  } else {
    endTitle.textContent = '💥 Game Over!';
    endStats.textContent = 'Score: ' + gameScore;
  }
  if (endScreen) endScreen.style.display = 'block';
}

/* Planet texture art — NASA maps embedded as data URIs (no external assets) */
const PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA = {
  sun: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mercury: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  venus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  earth: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mars: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  jupiter: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  saturn: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  uranus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  neptune: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
};

const StylizedPlanet = {
  NS: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
  TEXTURES: PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA,
  el(tag, a) {
    const e = document.createElementNS(this.NS, tag);
    for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]);
    return e;
  },
  svgRoot(g) {
    return g.ownerSVGElement || document.getElementById("planetSvg") || document.getElementById("solarSvg");
  },
  ensureClip(svg, id, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#" + id)) return "url(#" + id + ")";
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const cp = this.el("clipPath", { id: id });
    cp.appendChild(this.el("circle", { r: String(r) }));
    defs.appendChild(cp);
    return "url(#" + id + ")";
  },
  ensureShading(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sphereShade")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sphereShade", cx: "35%", cy: "32%", r: "65%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "0%", "stop-color": "#ffffff", "stop-opacity": "0.18" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0.42" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSunGlow(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sunCorona")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sunCorona", cx: "50%", cy: "50%", r: "50%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "85%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0.35" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#ffc107", "stop-opacity": "0.65" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#saturnRingBack")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const pad = r * 3;
    const back = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingBack" });
    back.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: String(-pad), width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(back);
    const front = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingFront" });
    front.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: "0", width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(front);
  },
  ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, clipUrl) {
    const S = this;
    const grp = S.el("g", { transform: "rotate(" + tilt + ")", "clip-path": clipUrl || "" });
    const bands = [
      [1.0, "rgba(210,185,140,0.62)", 1.0],
      [0.92, "rgba(235,215,175,0.55)", 0.75],
      [0.84, "rgba(185,155,105,0.48)", 0.55],
      [0.76, "rgba(225,205,165,0.42)", 0.45],
      [0.68, "rgba(170,140,95,0.36)", 0.35],
    ];
    bands.forEach(([scale, color, wScale]) => {
      grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
        cx: "0",
        cy: "0",
        rx: String(rx * scale),
        ry: String(ry * scale),
        fill: "none",
        stroke: color,
        "stroke-width": String(Math.max(0.8, sw * wScale)),
      }));
    });
    grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
      cx: "0",
      cy: "0",
      rx: String(rx * 0.79),
      ry: String(ry * 0.79),
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "rgba(8,6,20,0.55)",
      "stroke-width": String(Math.max(1.2, sw * 0.55)),
    }));
    g.appendChild(grp);
  },
  texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const tex = S.TEXTURES[type];
    if (!tex) return false;
    g.appendChild(S.el("image", {
      href: tex,
      x: String(-r),
      y: String(-r),
      width: String(r * 2),
      height: String(r * 2),
      preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid slice",
      "clip-path": clip,
    }));
    return true;
  },
  drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    const tilt = -18;
    const rx = r * 2.15;
    const ry = r * 0.48;
    const sw = Math.max(1, r * 0.09);
    if (svg) S.ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingBack)");
    S.texturedDisc(g, "saturn", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "saturn", r, clip);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingFront)");
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
      "clip-path": clip,
      "pointer-events": "none",
    }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  sphere(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (S.texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip)) {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
        r: String(r),
        fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
        "clip-path": clip,
        "pointer-events": "none",
      }));
    } else {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888", "clip-path": clip }));
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  drawSun(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    if (svg) S.ensureSunGlow(svg);
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.45), fill: "url(#sunCorona)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.2), fill: "rgba(255,193,7,0.18)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    S.texturedDisc(g, "sun", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "sun", r, clip);
  },
  draw(g, type, r) {
    r = r || 88;
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    const clipId = r === 88 ? "globe" : "globe-r" + Math.round(r * 10);
    const clip = svg ? S.ensureClip(svg, clipId, r) : "";
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (type === "saturn") {
      S.drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (type === "sun") {
      S.drawSun(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (S.TEXTURES[type]) {
      S.sphere(g, type, r, clip);
      return;
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888" }));
  },
};
function defaultPlanetZoom(svg, planetType) {
  const w = svg ? (svg.clientWidth || svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320) : 320;
  let zoom = w <= 360 ? 1.88 : w <= 480 ? 1.65 : w <= 640 ? 1.45 : w <= 820 ? 1.28 : 1.15;
  const fitRadius = 168;
  const bodyR = 88;
  if (planetType === "sun") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.5));
  } else if (planetType === "saturn") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 2.28));
  } else if (planetType === "meteor") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.35));
  } else if (planetType === "blackhole") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.92));
  }
  return Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
}
function makePlanetViewer(planetType, facts, label) {
  return {
    facts: facts, fi: 0, spin: true, zoom: 1.28, rot: 0, drag: 0, ang: 0.08,
    dragMoved: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, lx: 0, dragging: false,
    init() {
      this.svg = document.getElementById('planetSvg');
      this.g = document.getElementById('planetGroup');
      this.info = document.getElementById('planetInfo');
      if (!this.svg || !this.g || !this.info) return;
      const S = this;
      S.zoom = defaultPlanetZoom(this.svg, planetType);
const btnSpin = document.getElementById('btnSpin');
      btnSpin.onclick = () => {
        S.spin = !S.spin;
        btnSpin.textContent = S.spin ? 'Stop' : 'Spin';
        btnSpin.classList.toggle('active', !S.spin);
      };
      btnSpin.textContent = 'Stop';
      document.getElementById('btnZoomIn').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.min(2.2, S.zoom + 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnZoomOut').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.max(0.55, S.zoom - 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnRotL').onclick = () => { S.rot -= 18; };
      document.getElementById('btnRotR').onclick = () => { S.rot += 18; };
      const onDown = e => {
        S.dragging = true;
        S.dragMoved = false;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        S.startX = S.lx = p.clientX;
        S.startY = p.clientY;
      };
      const onMove = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        if (Math.hypot(p.clientX - S.startX, p.clientY - S.startY) > 12) S.dragMoved = true;
        if (S.dragging) { S.drag += (p.clientX - S.lx) * 0.35; S.lx = p.clientX; }
      };
      const onUp = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches[0] : e;
        if (!S.dragMoved && p && S.hitPlanet(p.clientX, p.clientY)) S.nextFact();
        if (S.dragging) { S.rot += S.drag; S.drag = 0; S.dragging = false; }
      };
      this.svg.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { onDown(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { onMove(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      const loop = () => { if (S.spin) S.ang += 0.012; S.draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
      this.draw();
      loop();
    },
    hitPlanet(clientX, clientY) {
      const pt = this.svg.createSVGPoint();
      pt.x = clientX;
      pt.y = clientY;
      const m = this.g.getScreenCTM();
      if (!m) return false;
      const p = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse());
      return p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 88 * 88;
    },
    nextFact() {
      this.fi = (this.fi + 1) % this.facts.length;
      this.info.innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong><br>' + this.facts[this.fi];
    },
    draw() {
      while (this.g.firstChild) this.g.removeChild(this.g.firstChild);
      this.g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(200,200) rotate(' + (this.rot + this.drag) + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ') rotate(' + this.ang + ')');
      StylizedPlanet.draw(this.g, planetType, 88);
    }
  };
}

const PlanetViewer = makePlanetViewer('mercury', mercuryFacts, '🪨 Mercury');

steps.title: Mercury Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Mercury Explained

Learn more about the smallest planet!

🌡️ Why is Mercury So Hot and Cold?

Mercury has no atmosphere - that means there's no air to trap heat like on Earth. During the day, the Sun heats up the surface quickly. At night, all that heat escapes into space because there's nothing to hold it in!

This is why Mercury has such extreme temperature changes between day and night.

💡 Fun Fact

Mercury's temperature can change by 600°C in a single day!

🔄 Strange Days and Years

Mercury has a very strange day and year cycle. One day on Mercury (sunrise to sunrise) takes 59 Earth days. But one year (orbit around the Sun) only takes 88 Earth days!

This means Mercury's day is longer than its year! If you lived on Mercury, you'd have birthdays more often than you'd have bedtimes!

🕳️ Mercury's Surface

Mercury looks a lot like our Moon. It's covered in craters from space rocks hitting it billions of years ago. The biggest crater is called Caloris Basin - it's huge!

There are also smooth plains called "maria" (seas in Latin), but they're made of hardened lava, not water. Mercury has no liquid water at all!

❄️ Ice on Mercury?

Even though Mercury is super hot, scientists have found ice in some craters near the poles! These craters are always in shadow, so the Sun never shines there.

The ice has been there for billions of years, protected from the Sun's heat!

💡 Fun Fact

Mercury might have more ice than our Moon!

🔭 Exploring Mercury

Scientists have sent spacecraft to study Mercury:

  • MARINER 10 - First spacecraft to visit Mercury in 1974
  • MESSENGER - Orbited Mercury from 2011 to 2015
  • BepiColombo - Arrived in 2025, still studying it

These missions help us learn more about this mysterious little planet!

🏋️ Gravity on Mercury

Mercury is much smaller than Earth, so its gravity is weaker too. If you weigh 30 kg on Earth, you would only weigh about 11 kg on Mercury!

You could jump much higher and lift much heavier things on Mercury!

<body class="reading-page">
<div class="stars"></div>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>❓ Mercury Quiz</h1>
  </div>

  <div class="competition-bar" id="liveScoreBar">
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="playerIcon">👨‍🚀</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="playerName2">Explorer</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="playerScore">0</div>
    </div>
    <div class="vs-divider">VS</div>
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="botIcon">🪨</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="botName">Hermes</div>
      <div class="competitor-score" id="computerScore">0</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card active" id="quizCard-1">
    <div class="question">1. What is special about Mercury's day and year?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, true)">A day is longer than a year</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">A year is longer than a day</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">They are the same length</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">Mercury has no days</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-1"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-2">
    <div class="question">2. How long is a year on Mercury?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">365 Earth days</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">180 Earth days</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, true)">88 Earth days</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">24 Earth days</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-2"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-3">
    <div class="question">3. Why is Mercury not the hottest planet?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">It's too far from the Sun</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, true)">It has no atmosphere to trap heat</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">It's always night there</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">It's made of ice</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-3"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-4">
    <div class="question">4. What covers Mercury's surface?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, true)">Craters</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Oceans</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Mountains</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Forests</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-5">
    <div class="question">5. Does Mercury have moons?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Yes, 2 moons</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Yes, 1 moon</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Yes, 10 moons</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, true)">No moons</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-5"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="score-card" id="scoreCard">
    <h2>🎉 Quiz Complete!</h2>
    <div class="podium" id="podium">
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-second">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-2">🪨</div>
        <div class="podium-bar second">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥈</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-2">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-2">Hermes</div>
      </div>
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-first">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-1">👨‍🚀</div>
        <div class="podium-bar first">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥇</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-1">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-1">Ariel</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="message" id="scoreMessage"></div>
    <div class="button-group">
      <button class="retry-btn" onclick="retryQuiz()">🔄 Try Again</button>
    </div>
  </div>

<div class="nav-hint">
  <div>💡 Use the ← → arrows in the top navigation bar to go to the next chapter.</div>
  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 5;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'Hermes';
  const botCharacter = '🪨';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>

        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 250px 160px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 650px 190px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),

      <canvas id="gameCanvasElement"></canvas>
      <div class="game-overlay" id="startScreen">
        <h3>🌋 Venus Volcano Escape</h3>
        <p>Dodge rocks 🪨 and lava splashes 🔥!<br>Use ← → keys or the buttons below.</p>
        <button class="overlay-btn" onclick="startGame()">▶️ Start Game</button>

      <div class="game-hud-item" id="gameScore">⭐ Score: 0</div>
      <div class="game-hud-item" id="gameTimer">⏱️ Time: 60s</div>
      <div class="game-hud-item" id="gameLives">❤️❤️❤️</div>
