<script>
const venusFacts = [
  "Venus is named after the Roman goddess of love and beauty!",
  "Venus has no moons!",
  "Venus has no rings!",
  "Venus is the brightest planet in our night sky!",
  "A day on Venus is longer than its year!",
  "Venus rotates backwards compared to other planets!",
  "Venus has over 1,600 volcanoes!",
  "Venus is sometimes called Earth's 'evil twin'!"
];
let factIndex = 0;

function showVenusFact() {
  PlanetViewer.nextFact();
}

// Venus Volcano Escape — dodge rocks, stay above rising lava, survive 60s
const SURVIVAL_TIME = 60;
const PLAYER_SIZE = 40;
const PLAYER_SPEED = 6;
const LAVA_RISE_SPEED = 0.06;
const INVINCIBLE_MS = 1500;

let gameScore = 0;
let gameTime = SURVIVAL_TIME;
let gameLives = 3;
let gameInterval;
let spawnRockInterval;
let spawnLavaInterval;
let animationFrame;
let isGameRunning = false;
let canvas, ctx;
let player;
let ground;
let rocks = [];
let lavaDrops = [];
let smoke = [];
let lavaLevel = 0;
let volcanoCracks = [];
let keys = {};
let moveLeft = false;
let moveRight = false;
let invincibleUntil = 0;
let controlsBound = false;

function updateHud() {
  document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = '⭐ Score: ' + gameScore;
  document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = '⏱️ Time: ' + gameTime + 's';
  document.getElementById('gameLives').textContent = '❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, gameLives));
}

function bindControls() {
  if (controlsBound) return;
  controlsBound = true;

  document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  document.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);

  const leftBtn = document.getElementById('leftBtn');
  const rightBtn = document.getElementById('rightBtn');

  leftBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveLeft = true; });
  leftBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveLeft = false; });
  rightBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveRight = true; });
  rightBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveRight = false; });
  leftBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => moveLeft = true);
  leftBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => moveLeft = false);
  leftBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => moveLeft = false);
  rightBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => moveRight = true);
  rightBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => moveRight = false);
  rightBtn.addEventListener('mouseleave', () => moveRight = false);
}

function initGround(w, h) {
  ground = {
    x: 20,
    y: h - 80,
    width: w - 40,
    height: 20,
    details: [
      { dx: w * 0.15, dy: 8, r: 3 },
      { dx: w * 0.4, dy: 10, r: 2 },
      { dx: w * 0.65, dy: 7, r: 3 },
      { dx: w * 0.85, dy: 9, r: 2 }
    ]
  };
}

function initBackground(w, h) {
  smoke = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
    smoke.push({
      x: w * 0.3 + Math.random() * w * 0.4,
      y: h * 0.45 + Math.random() * h * 0.15,
      radius: 14 + Math.random() * 22,
      speed: 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25,
      alpha: 0.08 + Math.random() * 0.12
    });
  }

  volcanoCracks = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    volcanoCracks.push({
      x: w * (0.25 + Math.random() * 0.5),
      y: h - 40 - Math.random() * 50,
      length: 20 + Math.random() * 35,
      angle: -Math.PI / 2 + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8,
      pulse: Math.random() * Math.PI * 2
    });
  }
}

function rectHit(ax, ay, aw, ah, bx, by, bw, bh) {
  return ax < bx + bw && ax + aw > bx && ay < by + bh && ay + ah > by;
}

function spawnRock() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  const size = 16 + Math.random() * 14;
  rocks.push({
    x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
    y: -size,
    width: size,
    height: size,
    speed: 2 + Math.random() * 2
  });
}

function spawnLavaDrop() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  lavaDrops.push({
    x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
    y: -10,
    radius: 7 + Math.random() * 5,
    speed: 1.2 + Math.random() * 0.8
  });
}

function loseLife() {
  if (Date.now() < invincibleUntil) return;
  gameLives--;
  invincibleUntil = Date.now() + INVINCIBLE_MS;
  player.x = canvas.width / 2;
  updateHud();
  if (gameLives <= 0) {
    endGame(false);
  }
}

function startGame() {
  if (isGameRunning) return;

  canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvasElement');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  const container = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  canvas.width = container.clientWidth;
  canvas.height = container.clientHeight;

  bindControls();
  isGameRunning = true;
  gameScore = 0;
  gameTime = SURVIVAL_TIME;
  gameLives = 3;
  lavaLevel = canvas.height;
  rocks = [];
  lavaDrops = [];
  invincibleUntil = 0;

  initGround(canvas.width, canvas.height);
  initBackground(canvas.width, canvas.height);

  player = {
    x: canvas.width / 2,
    y: ground.y - PLAYER_SIZE,
    size: PLAYER_SIZE
  };

  document.getElementById('startScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('endScreen').style.display = 'none';
  updateHud();

  clearInterval(gameInterval);
  clearInterval(spawnRockInterval);
  clearInterval(spawnLavaInterval);

  gameInterval = setInterval(() => {
    if (!isGameRunning) return;
    gameTime--;
    gameScore += 10;
    updateHud();
    if (gameTime <= 0) {
      endGame(true);
    }
  }, 1000);

  spawnRockInterval = setInterval(spawnRock, 1500);
  spawnLavaInterval = setInterval(spawnLavaDrop, 2200);

  gameLoop();
}

function handleKeyDown(e) {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') keys.left = true;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') keys.right = true;
  if (['ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', 'ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown'].includes(e.key)) {
    e.preventDefault();
  }
}

function handleKeyUp(e) {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') keys.left = false;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') keys.right = false;
}

function drawBackground() {
  const w = canvas.width;
  const h = canvas.height;

  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h);
  sky.addColorStop(0, '#ffb347');
  sky.addColorStop(0.45, '#ff7043');
  sky.addColorStop(1, '#bf360c');
  ctx.fillStyle = sky;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);

  // Volcano silhouette
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3e2723';
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(0, h);
  ctx.lineTo(w * 0.18, h - 70);
  ctx.lineTo(w * 0.38, h - 130);
  ctx.lineTo(w * 0.5, h - 155);
  ctx.lineTo(w * 0.62, h - 125);
  ctx.lineTo(w * 0.82, h - 65);
  ctx.lineTo(w, h);
  ctx.closePath();
  ctx.fill();

  // Glowing lava cracks
  volcanoCracks.forEach(crack => {
    crack.pulse += 0.06;
    const glow = 0.5 + Math.sin(crack.pulse) * 0.3;
    ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, ${Math.floor(120 + glow * 100)}, 0, ${0.5 + glow * 0.4})`;
    ctx.lineWidth = 3;
    ctx.shadowColor = '#ff6600';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 12;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(crack.x, crack.y);
    ctx.lineTo(
      crack.x + Math.cos(crack.angle) * crack.length,
      crack.y + Math.sin(crack.angle) * crack.length
    );
    ctx.stroke();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  });

  // Smoke plumes
  smoke.forEach(s => {
    s.y -= s.speed;
    if (s.y < h * 0.2) {
      s.y = h * 0.55 + Math.random() * 40;
      s.x = w * 0.35 + Math.random() * w * 0.3;
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(80, 40, 30, ${s.alpha})`;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
}

function drawGround() {
  if (ground.y + ground.height < lavaLevel - 10) return;

  const grad = ctx.createLinearGradient(ground.x, ground.y, ground.x, ground.y + ground.height);
  grad.addColorStop(0, '#a0522d');
  grad.addColorStop(1, '#5d4037');
  ctx.fillStyle = grad;
  ctx.fillRect(ground.x, ground.y, ground.width, ground.height);

  ctx.fillStyle = '#cd853f';
  ctx.fillRect(ground.x, ground.y, ground.width, 4);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.25)';
  ground.details.forEach(d => {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(ground.x + d.dx, ground.y + d.dy, d.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  });
}

function drawLava() {
  const w = canvas.width;
  const h = canvas.height;

  const lavaGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, lavaLevel - 40, 0, h);
  lavaGrad.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 200, 0, 0.95)');
  lavaGrad.addColorStop(0.35, '#ff5722');
  lavaGrad.addColorStop(1, '#b71c1c');
  ctx.fillStyle = lavaGrad;
  ctx.fillRect(0, lavaLevel, w, h - lavaLevel);

  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 100, 0.35)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const bx = (Date.now() / 40 + i * 80) % (w + 40) - 20;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.ellipse(bx, lavaLevel + 8 + (i % 3) * 6, 18, 6, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}

function drawPlayer() {
  const blink = Date.now() < invincibleUntil && Math.floor(Date.now() / 120) % 2 === 0;
  if (blink) return;

  ctx.font = `${player.size}px serif`;
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'bottom';
  ctx.fillText('🧑‍🚀', player.x, ground.y);
}

function gameLoop() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;

  drawBackground();
  drawGround();
  drawLava();

  if (keys.left || moveLeft) player.x -= PLAYER_SPEED;
  if (keys.right || moveRight) player.x += PLAYER_SPEED;
  player.x = Math.max(PLAYER_SIZE / 2, Math.min(canvas.width - PLAYER_SIZE / 2, player.x));
  player.y = ground.y - player.size;

  lavaLevel -= LAVA_RISE_SPEED;
  const lavaStop = ground.y + 35;
  if (lavaLevel < lavaStop) lavaLevel = lavaStop;

  // Falling lava drops
  for (let i = lavaDrops.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const drop = lavaDrops[i];
    drop.y += drop.speed;

    ctx.shadowColor = '#ff4500';
    ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ff6347';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(drop.x, drop.y, drop.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0;

    if (rectHit(
      player.x - player.size / 2, player.y, player.size, player.size,
      drop.x - drop.radius, drop.y - drop.radius, drop.radius * 2, drop.radius * 2
    )) {
      loseLife();
      lavaDrops.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }

    if (drop.y - drop.radius > canvas.height + 20) {
      lavaDrops.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  // Falling rocks
  for (let i = rocks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const rock = rocks[i];
    rock.y += rock.speed;

    ctx.font = `${rock.width}px serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('🪨', rock.x + rock.width / 2, rock.y + rock.height / 2);

    if (rectHit(
      player.x - player.size / 2, player.y, player.size, player.size,
      rock.x, rock.y, rock.width, rock.height
    )) {
      loseLife();
      rocks.splice(i, 1);
      continue;
    }

    if (rock.y > canvas.height + 20) {
      rocks.splice(i, 1);
    }
  }

  drawPlayer();

  animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function endGame(won) {
  isGameRunning = false;
  clearInterval(gameInterval);
  clearInterval(spawnRockInterval);
  clearInterval(spawnLavaInterval);
  cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);

  document.getElementById('endTitle').textContent = won ? '🎉 You Escaped!' : '💥 Game Over';
  document.getElementById('endStats').textContent = won
    ? `Score: ${gameScore} — You survived Venus!`
    : `Score: ${gameScore} — Time left: ${gameTime}s`;
  document.getElementById('endScreen').style.display = 'block';
}

/* Planet texture art — NASA maps embedded as data URIs (no external assets) */
const PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA = {
  sun: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mercury: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  venus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  earth: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mars: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  jupiter: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  saturn: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  uranus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  neptune: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
};

const StylizedPlanet = {
  NS: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
  TEXTURES: PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA,
  el(tag, a) {
    const e = document.createElementNS(this.NS, tag);
    for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]);
    return e;
  },
  svgRoot(g) {
    return g.ownerSVGElement || document.getElementById("planetSvg") || document.getElementById("solarSvg");
  },
  ensureClip(svg, id, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#" + id)) return "url(#" + id + ")";
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const cp = this.el("clipPath", { id: id });
    cp.appendChild(this.el("circle", { r: String(r) }));
    defs.appendChild(cp);
    return "url(#" + id + ")";
  },
  ensureShading(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sphereShade")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sphereShade", cx: "35%", cy: "32%", r: "65%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "0%", "stop-color": "#ffffff", "stop-opacity": "0.18" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0.42" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSunGlow(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sunCorona")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sunCorona", cx: "50%", cy: "50%", r: "50%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "85%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0.35" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#ffc107", "stop-opacity": "0.65" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#saturnRingBack")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const pad = r * 3;
    const back = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingBack" });
    back.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: String(-pad), width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(back);
    const front = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingFront" });
    front.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: "0", width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(front);
  },
  ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, clipUrl) {
    const S = this;
    const grp = S.el("g", { transform: "rotate(" + tilt + ")", "clip-path": clipUrl || "" });
    const bands = [
      [1.0, "rgba(210,185,140,0.62)", 1.0],
      [0.92, "rgba(235,215,175,0.55)", 0.75],
      [0.84, "rgba(185,155,105,0.48)", 0.55],
      [0.76, "rgba(225,205,165,0.42)", 0.45],
      [0.68, "rgba(170,140,95,0.36)", 0.35],
    ];
    bands.forEach(([scale, color, wScale]) => {
      grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
        cx: "0",
        cy: "0",
        rx: String(rx * scale),
        ry: String(ry * scale),
        fill: "none",
        stroke: color,
        "stroke-width": String(Math.max(0.8, sw * wScale)),
      }));
    });
    grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
      cx: "0",
      cy: "0",
      rx: String(rx * 0.79),
      ry: String(ry * 0.79),
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "rgba(8,6,20,0.55)",
      "stroke-width": String(Math.max(1.2, sw * 0.55)),
    }));
    g.appendChild(grp);
  },
  texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const tex = S.TEXTURES[type];
    if (!tex) return false;
    g.appendChild(S.el("image", {
      href: tex,
      x: String(-r),
      y: String(-r),
      width: String(r * 2),
      height: String(r * 2),
      preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid slice",
      "clip-path": clip,
    }));
    return true;
  },
  drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    const tilt = -18;
    const rx = r * 2.15;
    const ry = r * 0.48;
    const sw = Math.max(1, r * 0.09);
    if (svg) S.ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingBack)");
    S.texturedDisc(g, "saturn", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "saturn", r, clip);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingFront)");
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
      "clip-path": clip,
      "pointer-events": "none",
    }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  sphere(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (S.texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip)) {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
        r: String(r),
        fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
        "clip-path": clip,
        "pointer-events": "none",
      }));
    } else {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888", "clip-path": clip }));
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  drawSun(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    if (svg) S.ensureSunGlow(svg);
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.45), fill: "url(#sunCorona)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.2), fill: "rgba(255,193,7,0.18)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    S.texturedDisc(g, "sun", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "sun", r, clip);
  },
  draw(g, type, r) {
    r = r || 88;
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    const clipId = r === 88 ? "globe" : "globe-r" + Math.round(r * 10);
    const clip = svg ? S.ensureClip(svg, clipId, r) : "";
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (type === "saturn") {
      S.drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (type === "sun") {
      S.drawSun(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (S.TEXTURES[type]) {
      S.sphere(g, type, r, clip);
      return;
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888" }));
  },
};
function defaultPlanetZoom(svg, planetType) {
  const w = svg ? (svg.clientWidth || svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320) : 320;
  let zoom = w <= 360 ? 1.88 : w <= 480 ? 1.65 : w <= 640 ? 1.45 : w <= 820 ? 1.28 : 1.15;
  const fitRadius = 168;
  const bodyR = 88;
  if (planetType === "sun") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.5));
  } else if (planetType === "saturn") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 2.28));
  } else if (planetType === "meteor") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.35));
  } else if (planetType === "blackhole") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.92));
  }
  return Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
}
function makePlanetViewer(planetType, facts, label) {
  return {
    facts: facts, fi: 0, spin: true, zoom: 1.28, rot: 0, drag: 0, ang: 0.08,
    dragMoved: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, lx: 0, dragging: false,
    init() {
      this.svg = document.getElementById('planetSvg');
      this.g = document.getElementById('planetGroup');
      this.info = document.getElementById('planetInfo');
      if (!this.svg || !this.g || !this.info) return;
      const S = this;
      S.zoom = defaultPlanetZoom(this.svg, planetType);
const btnSpin = document.getElementById('btnSpin');
      btnSpin.onclick = () => {
        S.spin = !S.spin;
        btnSpin.textContent = S.spin ? 'Stop' : 'Spin';
        btnSpin.classList.toggle('active', !S.spin);
      };
      btnSpin.textContent = 'Stop';
      document.getElementById('btnZoomIn').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.min(2.2, S.zoom + 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnZoomOut').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.max(0.55, S.zoom - 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnRotL').onclick = () => { S.rot -= 18; };
      document.getElementById('btnRotR').onclick = () => { S.rot += 18; };
      const onDown = e => {
        S.dragging = true;
        S.dragMoved = false;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        S.startX = S.lx = p.clientX;
        S.startY = p.clientY;
      };
      const onMove = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        if (Math.hypot(p.clientX - S.startX, p.clientY - S.startY) > 12) S.dragMoved = true;
        if (S.dragging) { S.drag += (p.clientX - S.lx) * 0.35; S.lx = p.clientX; }
      };
      const onUp = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches[0] : e;
        if (!S.dragMoved && p && S.hitPlanet(p.clientX, p.clientY)) S.nextFact();
        if (S.dragging) { S.rot += S.drag; S.drag = 0; S.dragging = false; }
      };
      this.svg.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { onDown(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { onMove(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      const loop = () => { if (S.spin) S.ang += 0.012; S.draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
      this.draw();
      loop();
    },
    hitPlanet(clientX, clientY) {
      const pt = this.svg.createSVGPoint();
      pt.x = clientX;
      pt.y = clientY;
      const m = this.g.getScreenCTM();
      if (!m) return false;
      const p = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse());
      return p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 88 * 88;
    },
    nextFact() {
      this.fi = (this.fi + 1) % this.facts.length;
      this.info.innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong><br>' + this.facts[this.fi];
    },
    draw() {
      while (this.g.firstChild) this.g.removeChild(this.g.firstChild);
      this.g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(200,200) rotate(' + (this.rot + this.drag) + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ') rotate(' + this.ang + ')');
      StylizedPlanet.draw(this.g, planetType, 88);
    }
  };
}

const PlanetViewer = makePlanetViewer('venus', venusFacts, '🔥 Venus');
try { PlanetViewer.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Planet viewer:', err); }

</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: Venus Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Venus Explained

Learn more about the hottest planet!

🌡️ The Greenhouse Effect

Venus's thick atmosphere creates a powerful greenhouse effect. Carbon dioxide traps heat from the Sun, just like glass traps heat in a greenhouse.

This effect is so strong that Venus is hotter than Mercury, even though Mercury is closer to the Sun. The heat can't escape into space!

💡 Fun Fact

Venus's greenhouse effect is 90 times stronger than Earth's!

🔄 Backwards Day

Venus is the only planet that rotates backwards (retrograde rotation). This means if you could stand on Venus, you would see the Sun rise in the west and set in the east!

Scientists aren't sure why Venus rotates this way. It might have been hit by a huge space rock long ago that knocked it backwards.

☁️ The Clouds of Venus

Venus is covered in thick yellow clouds made of sulfuric acid. These clouds are about 20-30 km thick and reflect a lot of sunlight, making Venus very bright in our sky.

The clouds also create super strong winds - up to 360 km/h (224 mph) at the cloud tops! But on the surface, the air barely moves.

🏔️ Volcanoes Everywhere

Venus has more volcanoes than any other planet - over 1,600 major ones! Some of these might still be active today.

The surface also has large plains, high mountains, and deep valleys. The highest mountain on Venus is Maxwell Montes, which is 11 km high!

💡 Fun Fact

Venus's surface is about 500 million years old - younger than most planets!

🔭 Exploring Venus

Many spacecraft have visited Venus:

  • Venera - Soviet spacecraft that landed on Venus in the 1970s
  • Magellan - Mapped Venus's surface with radar in the 1990s
  • Venus Express - European mission from 2006-2014
  • Akatsuki - Japanese mission that arrived in 2015

🌍 Earth's Sister Planet

Venus and Earth are similar in size and are sometimes called "sister planets." But they're very different!

Venus has no water, no life, and a toxic atmosphere. It shows us what Earth might be like if the greenhouse effect got out of control.

<body class="reading-page">
<div class="stars"></div>
<div class="container">
  <div class="header">
    <h1>❓ Venus Quiz</h1>
  </div>

  <div class="competition-bar" id="liveScoreBar">
    <div class="competitor">
      <div class="competitor-icon" id="playerIcon">👨‍🚀</div>
      <div class="competitor-name" id="playerName2">Explorer</div>

      <div class="competitor-score" id="computerScore">0</div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card active" id="quizCard-1">
    <div class="question">1. Why is Venus the hottest planet?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">It's closest to the Sun</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, true)">Thick atmosphere traps heat</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">It has many volcanoes</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 1, false)">It's made of fire</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-1"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-2">
    <div class="question">2. What is special about Venus's rotation?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, true)">It rotates backwards</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">It doesn't rotate</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">It rotates sideways</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 2, false)">It's the fastest</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-2"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-3">
    <div class="question">3. What are Venus's clouds made of?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Water vapor</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Dust</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, true)">Sulfuric acid</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Carbon dioxide</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-3"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-4">
    <div class="question">4. How many volcanoes does Venus have?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">About 100</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">About 500</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, true)">Over 1,600</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">None</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-5">
    <div class="question">5. What planet is Venus similar in size to?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Mars</div>

      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-second">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-2">🔥</div>
        <div class="podium-bar second">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥈</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-2">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-2">Aphrodite</div>
      </div>

        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-1">👨‍🚀</div>
        <div class="podium-bar first">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥇</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-1">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-1">Ariel</div>

<div class="nav-hint">

  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 5;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'Aphrodite';
  const botCharacter = '🔥';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>

        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),

        /* North America */

        /* South America */

<script>
const earthFacts = [
  "Earth is about 4.5 billion years old!",
  "Earth is the only planet not named after a god!",
  "Earth's core is as hot as the Sun's surface!",
  "Earth has one moon!",
  "70% of Earth's surface is water!",
  "Earth is the densest planet in the solar system!",
  "Earth's atmosphere protects us from meteors!",
  "Earth is the only planet with life!"
];
let factIndex = 0;

function showEarthFact() {
  PlanetViewer.nextFact();
}

function checkFact(btn, isCorrect) {
  const result = document.getElementById('gameResult');
  if (isCorrect) {
    btn.classList.add('correct');
    result.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    result.style.color = '#4ade80';
  } else {
    btn.classList.add('wrong');
    result.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again!';
    result.style.color = '#f87171';
  }
}


function drawStarfield() {
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, canvas.height);
  g.addColorStop(0, '#050414');
  g.addColorStop(1, '#12102a');
  ctx.fillStyle = g;
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,' + (0.12 + (i % 5) * 0.12) + ')';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc((i * 131) % canvas.width, (i * 73) % canvas.height, 0.8 + (i % 3), 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
}
function formatHudTimeLives() {
  return '⏱ ' + gameTime + 's | ⚡' + gameEnergy + '% | ' + '❤️'.repeat(Math.max(0, gameLives)) + '🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - gameLives));
}
function startHudTimer() {
  if (typeof hudTimer !== 'undefined' && hudTimer) clearInterval(hudTimer);
  hudTimer = setInterval(function() {
    if (!isGameRunning) return;
    gameTime--;
    const el = document.getElementById('gameTimer');
    if (el) el.textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
    if (gameTime <= 0) endGame();
  }, 1000);
}
function loseLife() {
  gameLives--;
  const el = document.getElementById('gameTimer');
  if (el) el.textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
  if (gameLives <= 0) endGame();
}

// Space Station Builder Game - Canvas-based construction
let gameModules = 0;
let gameEnergy = 100;
let animationFrame;
let isGameRunning = false;
let canvas, ctx;
let builder;
let modules = [];
let energyOrbs = [];
let debris = [];
let keys = {};
let moveUp = false;
let moveDown = false;
let moveLeft = false;
let moveRight = false;
let gameTime = 90;
let gameLives = 3;
let hudTimer;

function startGame() {
  if (isGameRunning) return;
  const _ss = document.getElementById('startScreen'); if (_ss) _ss.style.display = 'none';
  const _es = document.getElementById('endScreen'); if (_es) _es.style.display = 'none';
  
  canvas = document.getElementById('gameCanvasElement');
  ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  
  // Set canvas size
  const canvasContainer = document.getElementById('gameCanvas');
  canvas.width = canvasContainer.clientWidth;
  canvas.height = canvasContainer.clientHeight;
  
  isGameRunning = true;
  gameModules = 0;
  gameEnergy = 100;
  gameTime = 90;
  gameLives = 3;
  modules = [];
  energyOrbs = [];
  debris = [];
  
  // Floating space debris obstacles
  for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    debris.push({
      x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - 80) + 40,
      y: Math.random() * (canvas.height - 80) + 40,
      r: 18 + Math.random() * 10,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2,
      vy: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.2
    });
  }
  
  // Initialize builder
  builder = {
    x: canvas.width / 2,
    y: canvas.height / 2,
    width: 30,
    height: 30,
    speed: 4,
    holdingModule: null
  };
  
  // Spawn initial energy orbs
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    spawnEnergyOrb();
  }
  
  document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Modules: 0';
  document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
  startHudTimer();
  
  // Enable controls
  document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  document.addEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
  
  // Touch controls
  const upBtn = document.getElementById('upBtn');
  const downBtn = document.getElementById('downBtn');
  const leftBtn = document.getElementById('leftBtn');
  const rightBtn = document.getElementById('rightBtn');
  const placeBtn = document.getElementById('placeBtn');
  
  upBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveUp = true; });
  upBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveUp = false; });
  downBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveDown = true; });
  downBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveDown = false; });
  leftBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveLeft = true; });
  leftBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveLeft = false; });
  rightBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveRight = true; });
  rightBtn.addEventListener('touchend', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); moveRight = false; });
  placeBtn.addEventListener('touchstart', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); if (builder.holdingModule) placeModule(); });
  
  upBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => moveUp = true);
  upBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => moveUp = false);
  downBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => moveDown = true);
  downBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => moveDown = false);
  leftBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => moveLeft = true);
  leftBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => moveLeft = false);
  rightBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => moveRight = true);
  rightBtn.addEventListener('mouseup', () => moveRight = false);
  placeBtn.addEventListener('mousedown', () => { if (builder.holdingModule) placeModule(); });
  
  // Start game loop
  gameLoop();
}

function handleKeyDown(e) {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w') {
    keys.up = true;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's') {
    keys.down = true;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') {
    keys.left = true;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') {
    keys.right = true;
  } else if (e.key === ' ' && builder.holdingModule) {
    // Place module
    placeModule();
  }
  
  // Prevent scrolling
  if (['ArrowUp', 'ArrowDown', 'ArrowLeft', 'ArrowRight', ' '].includes(e.key)) {
    e.preventDefault();
  }
}

function handleKeyUp(e) {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w') {
    keys.up = false;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowDown' || e.key === 's') {
    keys.down = false;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') {
    keys.left = false;
  } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') {
    keys.right = false;
  }
}

function spawnEnergyOrb() {
  energyOrbs.push({
    x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - 40) + 20,
    y: Math.random() * (canvas.height - 40) + 20,
    radius: 12,
    pulse: 0
  });
}

function placeModule() {
  if (builder.holdingModule && gameEnergy >= 20) {
    gameEnergy -= 20;
    if (gameEnergy <= 0) { loseLife(); if (isGameRunning) gameEnergy = 100; }
    document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
    
    modules.push({
      x: builder.x,
      y: builder.y,
      width: 40,
      height: 30,
      color: ['#4a90d9', '#6b93d6', '#87ceeb', '#4682b4'][gameModules % 4]
    });
    
    gameModules++;
    document.getElementById('gameScore').textContent = 'Modules: ' + gameModules;
    
    builder.holdingModule = null;
    
    // Spawn new energy orb
    if (energyOrbs.length < 5) {
      spawnEnergyOrb();
    }
    
    // Check win condition
    if (gameModules >= 10) {
      endGame();
    }
  }
}

function drawSatelliteModule(x, y, w) {
  ctx.save();
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
  const size = Math.max(42, w * 1.35);
  ctx.font = size + 'px "Segoe UI Emoji","Apple Color Emoji",sans-serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center';
  ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.85)';
  ctx.shadowBlur = 6;
  ctx.fillText('🛰️', x, y);
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0;
  ctx.restore();
}

function gameLoop() {
  if (!isGameRunning) return;
  
  // Clear canvas
  drawStarfield();
  
  // Draw Earth in background with improved graphics
  const earthGradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
    canvas.width / 2, canvas.height + 150, 0,
    canvas.width / 2, canvas.height + 150, 200
  );
  earthGradient.addColorStop(0, '#4a90d9');
  earthGradient.addColorStop(0.5, '#2d5a8a');
  earthGradient.addColorStop(1, '#1e3a5a');
  ctx.fillStyle = earthGradient;
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(canvas.width / 2, canvas.height + 150, 200, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Draw continents (simplified shapes)
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(76, 175, 80, 0.6)';
  
  // North America-like shape
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(canvas.width / 2 - 80, canvas.height + 50);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 - 60, canvas.height + 20, canvas.width / 2 - 40, canvas.height + 40);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 - 20, canvas.height + 30, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height + 60);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 20, canvas.height + 40, canvas.width / 2 + 40, canvas.height + 70);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 30, canvas.height + 100, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height + 120);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 - 30, canvas.height + 100, canvas.width / 2 - 80, canvas.height + 50);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Europe/Africa-like shape
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 20, canvas.height + 80);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 40, canvas.height + 60, canvas.width / 2 + 60, canvas.height + 70);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 80, canvas.height + 90, canvas.width / 2 + 70, canvas.height + 120);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 50, canvas.height + 140, canvas.width / 2 + 30, canvas.height + 130);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 10, canvas.height + 110, canvas.width / 2 + 20, canvas.height + 80);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Asia-like shape
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 70, canvas.height + 60);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 100, canvas.height + 40, canvas.width / 2 + 130, canvas.height + 70);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 140, canvas.height + 100, canvas.width / 2 + 120, canvas.height + 130);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 90, canvas.height + 120, canvas.width / 2 + 70, canvas.height + 60);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // South America-like shape
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(canvas.width / 2 - 30, canvas.height + 130);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 - 10, canvas.height + 150, canvas.width / 2 + 10, canvas.height + 180);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 - 10, canvas.height + 200, canvas.width / 2 - 40, canvas.height + 180);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 - 50, canvas.height + 150, canvas.width / 2 - 30, canvas.height + 130);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Australia-like shape
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.moveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 100, canvas.height + 160);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 130, canvas.height + 150, canvas.width / 2 + 140, canvas.height + 170);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 120, canvas.height + 190, canvas.width / 2 + 90, canvas.height + 180);
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(canvas.width / 2 + 95, canvas.height + 170, canvas.width / 2 + 100, canvas.height + 160);
  ctx.fill();
  
  // Clouds
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3)';
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    const cloudX = canvas.width / 2 + Math.sin(i * 1.5) * 100;
    const cloudY = canvas.height + 50 + i * 30;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(cloudX, cloudY, 15 + Math.random() * 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(cloudX + 15, cloudY - 5, 12 + Math.random() * 8, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.arc(cloudX + 30, cloudY, 10 + Math.random() * 6, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
  }
  
  // Update builder position
  if (keys.up || moveUp) builder.y -= builder.speed;
  if (keys.down || moveDown) builder.y += builder.speed;
  if (keys.left || moveLeft) builder.x -= builder.speed;
  if (keys.right || moveRight) builder.x += builder.speed;
  
  // Keep builder in bounds
  builder.x = Math.max(builder.width / 2, Math.min(canvas.width - builder.width / 2, builder.x));
  builder.y = Math.max(builder.height / 2, Math.min(canvas.height - builder.height / 2, builder.y));
  
  // Draw placed modules (satellites)
  modules.forEach((module, idx) => {
    drawSatelliteModule(module.x, module.y, module.width);
    if (idx > 0) {
      const prev = modules[idx - 1];
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(200,200,200,0.45)';
      ctx.lineWidth = 2;
      ctx.setLineDash([4, 4]);
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.moveTo(prev.x, prev.y);
      ctx.lineTo(module.x, module.y);
      ctx.stroke();
      ctx.setLineDash([]);
    }
  });
  
  // Draw & update debris obstacles
  debris.forEach(d => {
    d.x += d.vx; d.y += d.vy;
    if (d.x < d.r || d.x > canvas.width - d.r) d.vx *= -1;
    if (d.y < d.r || d.y > canvas.height - d.r) d.vy *= -1;
    ctx.font = (d.r * 1.4) + 'px serif';
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillText('☄️', d.x, d.y);
    if (Math.hypot(builder.x - d.x, builder.y - d.y) < d.r + builder.width / 2) {
      gameEnergy -= 25;
      d.x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - 80) + 40;
      d.y = Math.random() * (canvas.height - 80) + 40;
      if (gameEnergy <= 0) { loseLife(); if (isGameRunning) gameEnergy = 100; }
      document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
    }
  });
  
  // Draw energy orbs
  energyOrbs.forEach((orb, index) => {
    orb.pulse += 0.1;
    const pulseSize = Math.sin(orb.pulse) * 3;
    
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd700';
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(orb.x, orb.y, orb.radius + pulseSize, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    
    // Check collection
    if (!builder.holdingModule) {
      const dx = builder.x - orb.x;
      const dy = builder.y - orb.y;
      const distance = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
      
      if (distance < builder.width / 2 + orb.radius) {
        energyOrbs.splice(index, 1);
        builder.holdingModule = true;
        gameEnergy += 10;
        document.getElementById('gameTimer').textContent = formatHudTimeLives();
      }
    }
  });
  
  // Draw builder astronaut
  ctx.font = '28px serif';
  ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
  ctx.fillText(builder.holdingModule ? '🧑‍🚀📦' : '🧑‍🚀', builder.x, builder.y);
  
  animationFrame = requestAnimationFrame(gameLoop);
}

function endGame() {
  isGameRunning = false;
  if (hudTimer) clearInterval(hudTimer);
  cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrame);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keyup', handleKeyUp);
  const endScreen = document.getElementById('endScreen');
  const endTitle = document.getElementById('endTitle');
  const endStats = document.getElementById('endStats');
  if (endTitle) endTitle.textContent = gameModules >= 10 ? '🎉 Station Complete!' : '🛰️ Game Over!';
  if (endStats) endStats.textContent = 'Modules Built: ' + gameModules;
  if (endScreen) endScreen.style.display = 'block';
}
/* Planet texture art — NASA maps embedded as data URIs (no external assets) */
const PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA = {
  sun: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mercury: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  venus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  earth: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  mars: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  jupiter: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  saturn: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  uranus: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
  neptune: "data:image/jpeg;base64,",
};

const StylizedPlanet = {
  NS: "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg",
  TEXTURES: PLANET_TEXTURE_DATA,
  el(tag, a) {
    const e = document.createElementNS(this.NS, tag);
    for (const k in a) e.setAttribute(k, a[k]);
    return e;
  },
  svgRoot(g) {
    return g.ownerSVGElement || document.getElementById("planetSvg") || document.getElementById("solarSvg");
  },
  ensureClip(svg, id, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#" + id)) return "url(#" + id + ")";
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const cp = this.el("clipPath", { id: id });
    cp.appendChild(this.el("circle", { r: String(r) }));
    defs.appendChild(cp);
    return "url(#" + id + ")";
  },
  ensureShading(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sphereShade")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sphereShade", cx: "35%", cy: "32%", r: "65%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "0%", "stop-color": "#ffffff", "stop-opacity": "0.18" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#000000", "stop-opacity": "0.42" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSunGlow(svg) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#sunCorona")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const rg = this.el("radialGradient", { id: "sunCorona", cx: "50%", cy: "50%", r: "50%" });
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "55%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "85%", "stop-color": "#ff9800", "stop-opacity": "0.35" }));
    rg.appendChild(this.el("stop", { offset: "100%", "stop-color": "#ffc107", "stop-opacity": "0.65" }));
    defs.appendChild(rg);
  },
  ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r) {
    if (svg.querySelector("#saturnRingBack")) return;
    let defs = svg.querySelector("defs");
    if (!defs) {
      defs = this.el("defs", {});
      svg.insertBefore(defs, svg.firstChild);
    }
    const pad = r * 3;
    const back = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingBack" });
    back.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: String(-pad), width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(back);
    const front = this.el("clipPath", { id: "saturnRingFront" });
    front.appendChild(this.el("rect", { x: String(-pad), y: "0", width: String(pad * 2), height: String(pad) }));
    defs.appendChild(front);
  },
  ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, clipUrl) {
    const S = this;
    const grp = S.el("g", { transform: "rotate(" + tilt + ")", "clip-path": clipUrl || "" });
    const bands = [
      [1.0, "rgba(210,185,140,0.62)", 1.0],
      [0.92, "rgba(235,215,175,0.55)", 0.75],
      [0.84, "rgba(185,155,105,0.48)", 0.55],
      [0.76, "rgba(225,205,165,0.42)", 0.45],
      [0.68, "rgba(170,140,95,0.36)", 0.35],
    ];
    bands.forEach(([scale, color, wScale]) => {
      grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
        cx: "0",
        cy: "0",
        rx: String(rx * scale),
        ry: String(ry * scale),
        fill: "none",
        stroke: color,
        "stroke-width": String(Math.max(0.8, sw * wScale)),
      }));
    });
    grp.appendChild(S.el("ellipse", {
      cx: "0",
      cy: "0",
      rx: String(rx * 0.79),
      ry: String(ry * 0.79),
      fill: "none",
      stroke: "rgba(8,6,20,0.55)",
      "stroke-width": String(Math.max(1.2, sw * 0.55)),
    }));
    g.appendChild(grp);
  },
  texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const tex = S.TEXTURES[type];
    if (!tex) return false;
    g.appendChild(S.el("image", {
      href: tex,
      x: String(-r),
      y: String(-r),
      width: String(r * 2),
      height: String(r * 2),
      preserveAspectRatio: "xMidYMid slice",
      "clip-path": clip,
    }));
    return true;
  },
  drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    const tilt = -18;
    const rx = r * 2.15;
    const ry = r * 0.48;
    const sw = Math.max(1, r * 0.09);
    if (svg) S.ensureSaturnRingClips(svg, r);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingBack)");
    S.texturedDisc(g, "saturn", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "saturn", r, clip);
    S.ringEllipses(g, rx, ry, sw, tilt, "url(#saturnRingFront)");
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
      "clip-path": clip,
      "pointer-events": "none",
    }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  sphere(g, type, r, clip) {
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (S.texturedDisc(g, type, r, clip)) {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
        r: String(r),
        fill: "url(#sphereShade)",
        "clip-path": clip,
        "pointer-events": "none",
      }));
    } else {
      g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888", "clip-path": clip }));
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", {
      r: String(r),
      fill: "rgba(0,0,0,0.001)",
      "pointer-events": "all",
      style: "cursor:pointer",
    }));
  },
  drawSun(g, r, clip, svg) {
    const S = this;
    if (svg) S.ensureSunGlow(svg);
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.45), fill: "url(#sunCorona)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r * 1.2), fill: "rgba(255,193,7,0.18)", "pointer-events": "none" }));
    S.texturedDisc(g, "sun", r, clip) || S.sphere(g, "sun", r, clip);
  },
  draw(g, type, r) {
    r = r || 88;
    const S = this;
    const svg = S.svgRoot(g);
    const clipId = r === 88 ? "globe" : "globe-r" + Math.round(r * 10);
    const clip = svg ? S.ensureClip(svg, clipId, r) : "";
    if (svg) S.ensureShading(svg);
    if (type === "saturn") {
      S.drawSaturn(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (type === "sun") {
      S.drawSun(g, r, clip, svg);
      return;
    }
    if (S.TEXTURES[type]) {
      S.sphere(g, type, r, clip);
      return;
    }
    g.appendChild(S.el("circle", { r: String(r), fill: "#888" }));
  },
};
function defaultPlanetZoom(svg, planetType) {
  const w = svg ? (svg.clientWidth || svg.getBoundingClientRect().width || 320) : 320;
  let zoom = w <= 360 ? 1.88 : w <= 480 ? 1.65 : w <= 640 ? 1.45 : w <= 820 ? 1.28 : 1.15;
  const fitRadius = 168;
  const bodyR = 88;
  if (planetType === "sun") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.5));
  } else if (planetType === "saturn") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 2.28));
  } else if (planetType === "meteor") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.35));
  } else if (planetType === "blackhole") {
    zoom = Math.min(zoom, fitRadius / (bodyR * 1.92));
  }
  return Math.round(zoom * 100) / 100;
}
function makePlanetViewer(planetType, facts, label) {
  return {
    facts: facts, fi: 0, spin: true, zoom: 1.28, rot: 0, drag: 0, ang: 0.08,
    dragMoved: false, startX: 0, startY: 0, lx: 0, dragging: false,
    init() {
      this.svg = document.getElementById('planetSvg');
      this.g = document.getElementById('planetGroup');
      this.info = document.getElementById('planetInfo');
      if (!this.svg || !this.g || !this.info) return;
      const S = this;
      S.zoom = defaultPlanetZoom(this.svg, planetType);
const btnSpin = document.getElementById('btnSpin');
      btnSpin.onclick = () => {
        S.spin = !S.spin;
        btnSpin.textContent = S.spin ? 'Stop' : 'Spin';
        btnSpin.classList.toggle('active', !S.spin);
      };
      btnSpin.textContent = 'Stop';
      document.getElementById('btnZoomIn').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.min(2.2, S.zoom + 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnZoomOut').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.max(0.55, S.zoom - 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnRotL').onclick = () => { S.rot -= 18; };
      document.getElementById('btnRotR').onclick = () => { S.rot += 18; };
      const onDown = e => {
        S.dragging = true;
        S.dragMoved = false;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        S.startX = S.lx = p.clientX;
        S.startY = p.clientY;
      };
      const onMove = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        if (Math.hypot(p.clientX - S.startX, p.clientY - S.startY) > 12) S.dragMoved = true;
        if (S.dragging) { S.drag += (p.clientX - S.lx) * 0.35; S.lx = p.clientX; }
      };
      const onUp = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches[0] : e;
        if (!S.dragMoved && p && S.hitPlanet(p.clientX, p.clientY)) S.nextFact();
        if (S.dragging) { S.rot += S.drag; S.drag = 0; S.dragging = false; }
      };
      this.svg.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { onDown(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { onMove(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      const loop = () => { if (S.spin) S.ang += 0.012; S.draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
      this.draw();
      loop();
    },
    hitPlanet(clientX, clientY) {
      const pt = this.svg.createSVGPoint();
      pt.x = clientX;
      pt.y = clientY;
      const m = this.g.getScreenCTM();
      if (!m) return false;
      const p = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse());
      return p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 88 * 88;
    },
    nextFact() {
      this.fi = (this.fi + 1) % this.facts.length;
      this.info.innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong><br>' + this.facts[this.fi];
    },
    draw() {
      while (this.g.firstChild) this.g.removeChild(this.g.firstChild);
      this.g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(200,200) rotate(' + (this.rot + this.drag) + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ') rotate(' + this.ang + ')');
      StylizedPlanet.draw(this.g, planetType, 88);
    }
  };
}

const PlanetViewer = makePlanetViewer('earth', earthFacts, '🌍 Earth');
try { PlanetViewer.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Planet viewer:', err); }

</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: Earth Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 Earth Explained

Learn more about our home!

🌍 The Goldilocks Planet

Earth is often called the "Goldilocks Planet" because it's just right for life! It's not too close to the Sun (like Venus) and not too far (like Mars).

This perfect distance allows liquid water to exist, which is essential for all life as we know it.

💡 Fun Fact

If Earth were 5% closer to the Sun, it would be too hot for life. If it were 5% farther, it would be too cold!

🌊 The Water Planet

About 71% of Earth's surface is covered in water. This is why Earth looks blue from space! The water is in oceans, seas, lakes, rivers, and even underground.

Only about 3% of Earth's water is fresh water - the rest is salt water in the oceans. And most of the fresh water is frozen in ice!

🌬️ Earth's Atmosphere

Earth's atmosphere is a layer of gases that surrounds the planet. It's made mostly of nitrogen (78%) and oxygen (21%).

The atmosphere:

  • Protects us from harmful radiation
  • Keeps the planet warm enough for life
  • Burns up most space rocks before they hit the ground
  • Provides the oxygen we breathe

🧲 Earth's Magnetic Field

Earth has a strong magnetic field that acts like a giant shield. It protects us from dangerous particles coming from the Sun (solar wind).

This magnetic field is created by the movement of liquid iron in Earth's outer core. It's what makes compasses work!

💡 Fun Fact

Earth's magnetic field extends thousands of kilometers into space!

🌙 The Moon's Influence

Earth's Moon is very important for life on Earth:

  • It causes ocean tides (the rising and falling of sea levels)
  • It stabilizes Earth's rotation, keeping our seasons regular
  • It provides light at night
  • It may have helped life spread across Earth

🏔️ Earth's Changing Surface

Earth's surface is always changing! Plate tectonics (moving pieces of Earth's crust) create mountains, volcanoes, and earthquakes.

Weather and erosion (wind and water) also shape the land over millions of years. This is why Earth has such diverse landscapes!

💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.

        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 20px 30px,#fff,transparent),

        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 250px 160px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 300px 90px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 350px 130px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 400px 60px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 450px 180px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 500px 100px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 550px 140px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 600px 70px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 650px 190px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 700px 110px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 750px 150px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(2px 2px at 800px 80px,#fff,transparent),
        radial-gradient(1px 1px at 850px 170px,#fff,transparent);
      background-size:900px 200px;
      animation:twinkle 4s ease-in-out infinite;
      z-index:0;
    }
    @keyframes twinkle{
      0%,100%{opacity:0.3;}
      50%{opacity:0.8;}
    }
    .container{
      max-width:640px;
      margin:auto;
      padding:12px 16px 20px;
      position:relative;
      z-index:1;
    }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .container {

      }
    }
    .header{
      text-align:center;
      margin-bottom:12px;
    }
    h1{
      font-size:24px;
      color:#4a90d9;
      margin-bottom:4px;
    }
    .subtitle{
      color:#c4b5fd;
      font-size:16px;
    }
    .player-info{
      display:flex;
      align-items:center;
      justify-content:center;

      margin-top:6px;

    .competition-bar{
      display:flex;
      justify-content:space-between;
      align-items:center;
      background:#1a1735;
      border-radius:12px;
      padding:10px;

      display:flex;

    }
    .option.correct{
      background:rgba(34,197,94,0.3);

    }

      border-color:#ef4444;

    }

      background:rgba(34,197,94,0.2);
      color:#4ade80;
    }
    .feedback.wrong{
      background:rgba(239,68,68,0.2);
      color:#f87171;
    }
    .score-card{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,215,0,0.98), rgba(255,165,0,0.98));
      border-radius:24px;
      padding:10px 20px 60px;
      text-align:center;
      margin-top:20px;
      display:none;
      box-shadow: 0 16px 48px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.35);
      border:4px solid #fff176;
      z-index: 10;
      position: relative;
    }
    .score-card.show{
      display:block;
      animation: slideUp 0.5s ease-out;
    }
    @keyframes slideUp {
      from {
        opacity: 0;
        transform: translateY(30px);
      }
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }
    .score-card h2{
      font-size:26px;
      margin-top: 0;
      margin-bottom:30px;
      color:#1a1240;
      text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.4);
    }
    .score-display{
      background:linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1240, #3a2f70);
      border-radius:18px;
      padding:18px;
      margin-bottom:18px;

    <div class="question">4. What causes ocean tides?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">The Sun</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, true)">The Moon</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Wind</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Earth's rotation</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-5">
    <div class="question">5. Why is Earth called the "Goldilocks Planet"?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">It's made of gold</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">It has bears</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, true)">It's just right for life</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">It's the biggest planet</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-5"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="score-card" id="scoreCard">
    <h2>🎉 Quiz Complete!</h2>
    <div class="podium" id="podium">
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-second">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-2">🌍</div>
        <div class="podium-bar second">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥈</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-2">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-2">Gaia</div>
      </div>
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-first">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-1">👨‍🚀</div>
        <div class="podium-bar first">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥇</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-1">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-1">Ariel</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="message" id="scoreMessage"></div>
    <div class="button-group">
      <button class="retry-btn" onclick="retryQuiz()">🔄 Try Again</button>
    </div>
  </div>

<div class="nav-hint">
  <div>💡 Use the ← → arrows in the top navigation bar to go to the next chapter.</div>
  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 5;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'Gaia';
  const botCharacter = '🌍';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>
