  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-3">
    <div class="question">3. Which planet is known as the "Red Planet"?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Venus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, true)">Mars</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Jupiter</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 3, false)">Saturn</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-3"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-4">
    <div class="question">4. Which planet is the largest?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Earth</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Saturn</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, true)">Jupiter</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 4, false)">Neptune</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-4"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-5">
    <div class="question">5. Which planet has beautiful rings?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Jupiter</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, true)">Saturn</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Uranus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 5, false)">Neptune</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-5"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-6">
    <div class="question">6. Which planet is the hottest?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, false)">Mercury</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, true)">Venus</div>

      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 6, false)">The Sun</div>

    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-6"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-7">
    <div class="question">7. Which planet is the smallest?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 7, true)">Mercury</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 7, false)">Venus</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 7, false)">Mars</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 7, false)">Earth</div>
    </div>
    <div class="feedback" id="feedback-7"></div>
  </div>

  <div class="quiz-card" id="quizCard-8">
    <div class="question">8. Which planet is our home?</div>
    <div class="options">
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 8, false)">Mars</div>
      <div class="option" onclick="checkAnswer(this, 8, false)">Venus</div>

  </div>

    <h2>🎉 Quiz Complete!</h2>
    <div class="podium" id="podium">
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-second">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-2">🤖</div>
        <div class="podium-bar second">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥈</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-2">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-2">SolarBot</div>
      </div>
      <div class="podium-place" id="podium-first">
        <div class="podium-character" id="podium-char-1">👨‍🚀</div>
        <div class="podium-bar first">
          <span class="rank-badge">🥇</span>
        </div>
        <div class="podium-score" id="podium-score-1">0</div>
        <div class="podium-name" id="podium-name-1">Ariel</div>
      </div>
    </div>

      <button class="retry-btn" onclick="retryQuiz()">🔄 Try Again</button>

<div class="nav-hint">
  <div>💡 Use the ← → arrows in the top navigation bar to go to the next chapter.</div>
  <div>💡 Use the 🏠 button in the top navigation bar to go back to the Home page.</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
let score = 0;
let currentQuestion = 1;
const totalQuestions = 8;
let computerScore = 0;

function checkAnswer(element, questionNum, isCorrect) {
  const parent = element.parentElement;
  const options = parent.querySelectorAll('.option');
  const feedback = document.getElementById('feedback-' + questionNum);
  
  options.forEach(opt => {
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
  });
  
  // Computer answers randomly (70% chance of being correct)
  const computerCorrect = Math.random() < 0.7;
  if (computerCorrect) {
    computerScore++;
    document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = computerScore;
  }
  
  if (isCorrect) {
    element.classList.add('correct');
    feedback.textContent = '✅ Correct! Great job!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show correct';
    score++;
    document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = score;
  } else {
    element.classList.add('wrong');
    feedback.textContent = '❌ Not quite. Try again next time!';
    feedback.className = 'feedback show wrong';
  }
  
  setTimeout(() => {
    nextQuestion();
  }, 1500);
}

function nextQuestion() {
  const currentCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
  currentCard.classList.remove('active');
  
  currentQuestion++;
  
  if (currentQuestion <= totalQuestions) {
    const nextCard = document.getElementById('quizCard-' + currentQuestion);
    nextCard.classList.add('active');
  } else {
    showScore();
  }
}


function showScore() {
  const scoreCard = document.getElementById('scoreCard');
  const scoreMessage = document.getElementById('scoreMessage');
  const podium = document.getElementById('podium');
  
  
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const botName = 'SolarBot';
  const botCharacter = '🤖';
  
  // Create competitors array with scores
  const competitors = [
    { name: userName, character: userCharacter, score: score, isPlayer: true },
    { name: botName, character: botCharacter, score: computerScore, isPlayer: false }
  ];
  
  // Sort by score (descending)
  competitors.sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  
  // Update podium
  document.getElementById('podium-char-1').textContent = competitors[0].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-1').textContent = competitors[0].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-1').textContent = competitors[0].score;
  
  document.getElementById('podium-char-2').textContent = competitors[1].character;
  document.getElementById('podium-name-2').textContent = competitors[1].name;
  document.getElementById('podium-score-2').textContent = competitors[1].score;
  
  // Update message
  if (competitors[0].isPlayer) {
    scoreMessage.textContent = '🎉 ' + userName + ' wins! Amazing job!';
  } else {
    scoreMessage.textContent = competitors[0].name + ' won this time. Try again!';
  }
  
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.add('hidden');
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
  podium.style.display = 'flex';
  scoreCard.classList.add('show');
}

function retryQuiz() {
  score = 0;
  currentQuestion = 1;
  computerScore = 0;
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.quiz-card').forEach((card, index) => {
    card.classList.remove('active');
    if (index === 0) card.classList.add('active');
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach(opt => {
    opt.classList.remove('correct', 'wrong');
    opt.style.pointerEvents = 'auto';
  });
  
  document.querySelectorAll('.feedback').forEach(fb => {
    fb.classList.remove('show', 'correct', 'wrong');
  });
  
  document.getElementById('scoreCard').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('liveScoreBar').classList.remove('hidden');
  document.getElementById('playerScore').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('computerScore').textContent = '0';
}

// Load player info from page 3 character selection
function loadPlayerInfo() {
  const userName = SolarPlayer.getUserName() || 'Explorer';
  const userCharacter = SolarPlayer.getCharacter() || '👨‍🚀';
  const playerName2 = document.getElementById('playerName2');
  const playerIcon = document.getElementById('playerIcon');
  const podiumChar = document.getElementById('podium-char-1');
  const podiumName = document.getElementById('podium-name-1');
  if (playerName2) playerName2.textContent = userName;
  if (playerIcon) playerIcon.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumChar) podiumChar.textContent = userCharacter;
  if (podiumName) podiumName.textContent = userName;
}
loadPlayerInfo();

</script>
</body>
</html>

  sunCanvas.width = wrap.clientWidth;
  sunCanvas.height = wrap.clientHeight;
  document.getElementById('sunStartScreen').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('sunEndScreen').style.display = 'none';
  const dragHint = document.getElementById('sunDragHint');
  if (dragHint) dragHint.style.display = 'block';
  sunRunning = true;
  sunTime = 90; sunLives = 3; sunHeight = 0; sunCamY = 0;
  sunFlares = [];
  sunKeys = {}; sunDragMove = 0; sunJumpReq = false; sunDragPointerId = null;
  sunPhys = sunPhysicsFor(sunCanvas.width, sunCanvas.height);
  sunPlatforms = buildSunPlatforms(sunCanvas.width, sunCanvas.height, sunPhys);
  const startPlat = sunPlatforms.find(p => p.isStart) || sunPlatforms.filter(p => !p.isSun).reduce((a, b) => (a.y > b.y ? a : b));
  sunStartPlat = startPlat;
  sunPlayer = {
    x: startPlat.x + startPlat.width / 2,
    y: startPlat.y - 14,
    w: 24, h: 28, vx: 0, vy: 0, onGround: true

  sunCamY = sunBottomCamY(startPlat, sunCanvas.height);
  updateSunHud();
  document.addEventListener('keydown', sunKeyDown);
  document.addEventListener('keyup', sunKeyUp);
  bindSunDragControls();

function buildSunPlatforms(w, h, phys) {
  phys = phys || sunPhysicsFor(w, h);
  const sunCx = w / 2;
  const sunW = Math.max(104, 108);
  const plats = [{
    x: sunCx - sunW / 2,
    y: SUN_CENTER_Y,
    width: sunW,
    h: 14,
    isSun: true,
    sunR: SUN_BODY_RADIUS,
    sunCx: sunCx,
    sunCy: SUN_CENTER_Y
  }];
  const gapMin = Math.max(22, phys.maxJumpH * 0.36);
  const gapMax = Math.max(gapMin + 8, phys.maxJumpH * 0.5);
  const maxDx = Math.min(phys.maxJumpX, w * 0.34);
  const sunBottom = SUN_CENTER_Y + SUN_BODY_RADIUS;
  const minPlatY = sunBottom + gapMin * 0.82;
  const steps = Math.max(28, Math.round(h * 2.6 / gapMin));
  let y = h - 20;
  const startW = Math.max(88, Math.min(w - 24, 124));
  let prevCx = sunCx;
  plats.push({ x: prevCx - startW / 2, y: y, width: startW, h: 14, isStart: true });
  for (let i = 0; i < steps; i++) {
    const nextY = y - (gapMin + Math.random() * (gapMax - gapMin));
    if (nextY < minPlatY) break;
    y = nextY;
    const pw = Math.max(72, Math.min(w * 0.3, 78 + Math.random() * 36));
    const dx = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * maxDx;
    let cx = prevCx + dx;
    cx = Math.max(pw / 2 + 10, Math.min(w - pw / 2 - 10, cx));
    plats.push({ x: cx - pw / 2, y: y, width: pw, h: 14 });
    prevCx = cx;
  }
  const regular = plats.filter(p => !p.isSun);
  const closest = regular.reduce((a, b) => (a.y < b.y ? a : b), regular[0]);
  const approachTop = sunBottom + gapMin * 0.78;
  if (!closest || closest.y > approachTop + gapMax * 0.55) {
    const pw = Math.max(84, Math.min(w * 0.34, 102));
    plats.push({ x: sunCx - pw / 2, y: approachTop, width: pw, h: 14, isApproach: true });
  }
  return plats.filter(p => p.isSun || p.y >= minPlatY - 4);
}

function resetSunDrag() {
  sunDragMove = 0;
  sunDragPointerId = null;
}

function bindSunDragControls() {
  const wrap = document.getElementById('sunGameWrap');
  if (!wrap || wrap._dragBound) return;
  wrap._dragBound = true;
  const DRAG_DEAD = 10;
  const MOVE_SCALE = 72;
  const FLICK_UP = -32;
  const TAP_MAX_DIST = 18;
  const TAP_MAX_MS = 280;

  function onDown(e) {
    if (!sunRunning || e.target.closest('.game-overlay') || e.target.closest('.overlay-btn')) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    sunDragPointerId = e.pointerId;
    sunDragStartX = e.clientX;
    sunDragStartY = e.clientY;
    sunDragStartTime = Date.now();
    sunDragMove = 0;
    wrap.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
  }

  function onMove(e) {
    if (sunDragPointerId !== e.pointerId || !sunRunning) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const dx = e.clientX - sunDragStartX;
    const dy = e.clientY - sunDragStartY;
    if (Math.abs(dx) > DRAG_DEAD) {
      sunDragMove = Math.max(-1, Math.min(1, dx / MOVE_SCALE));
    } else {
      sunDragMove = 0;
    }
    if (dy < FLICK_UP && sunPlayer && sunPlayer.onGround) {
      sunJumpReq = true;
      sunDragStartY = e.clientY;
    }
  }

  function onUp(e) {
    if (sunDragPointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
    const dx = e.clientX - sunDragStartX;
    const dy = e.clientY - sunDragStartY;
    const elapsed = Date.now() - sunDragStartTime;
    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
    if ((dist < TAP_MAX_DIST && elapsed < TAP_MAX_MS) || dy < FLICK_UP) {
      sunJumpReq = true;
    }
    resetSunDrag();
  }

  wrap.addEventListener('pointerdown', onDown);
  wrap.addEventListener('pointermove', onMove);
  wrap.addEventListener('pointerup', onUp);
  wrap.addEventListener('pointercancel', onUp);
}

function sunKeyDown(e) {
  if (!sunRunning) return;
  if (['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp',' '].includes(e.key)) e.preventDefault();
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') sunKeys.left = true;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') sunKeys.right = true;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'w' || e.key === ' ') sunJumpReq = true;
}

function sunKeyUp(e) {
  if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a') sunKeys.left = false;
  if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'd') sunKeys.right = false;
}

function updateSunHud() {
  document.getElementById('sunGameTimer').textContent = '⏱ ' + sunTime + 's | ' + '❤️'.repeat(sunLives) + '🖤'.repeat(Math.max(0, 3 - sunLives));
}

function sunBottomCamY(plat, canvasH) {
  if (!plat) return 0;
  return Math.max(0, plat.y + plat.h - canvasH + 6);
}

function playerTouchesSun(p) {
  const sun = sunPlatforms.find(pl => pl.isSun);
  if (!sun) return false;
  const cx = sun.sunCx || (sun.x + sun.width / 2);
  const cy = sun.sunCy || sun.y;
  const sunR = sun.sunR || SUN_BODY_RADIUS;
  const hitR = sunR + SUN_RAY_LEN + 12;
  const dx = p.x - cx;
  const dy = p.y - cy;
  if (Math.hypot(dx, dy) <= hitR) return true;
  const pad = 16;
  return p.y <= cy + sunR + pad &&
    p.y >= cy - sunR - SUN_RAY_LEN &&
    Math.abs(p.x - cx) <= sunR + SUN_RAY_LEN + pad;
}

function endSunClimb(won) {
  sunRunning = false;
  sunKeys = {}; sunDragMove = 0; sunJumpReq = false;
  resetSunDrag();
  const dragHint = document.getElementById('sunDragHint');
  if (dragHint) dragHint.style.display = 'none';
  cancelAnimationFrame(sunAnimId);
  clearInterval(sunTimerId);
  document.removeEventListener('keydown', sunKeyDown);
  document.removeEventListener('keyup', sunKeyUp);
  document.getElementById('sunEndTitle').textContent = won ? '☀️ You Reached the Sun!' : '💥 Solar Fall!';
  document.getElementById('sunEndStats').textContent = 'Height: ' + sunHeight + 'm | Time left: ' + sunTime + 's';
  document.getElementById('sunEndScreen').style.display = 'flex';
}

function sunLoop() {
  if (!sunRunning) return;
  const p = sunPlayer;
  const grav = sunPhys.grav;
  const jumpV = sunPhys.jumpV;
  const speed = sunPhys.speed;
  let move = 0;
  if (sunKeys.left) move = -1;
  else if (sunKeys.right) move = 1;
  else if (Math.abs(sunDragMove) > 0.08) move = sunDragMove;
  if (move !== 0) p.vx = move * speed;
  else p.vx *= 0.75;
  if (sunJumpReq && p.onGround) { p.vy = jumpV; p.onGround = false; }
  sunJumpReq = false;
  p.vy += grav;
  p.x += p.vx;
  p.y += p.vy;
  p.x = Math.max(p.w, Math.min(sunCanvas.width - p.w, p.x));
  if (playerTouchesSun(p)) { endSunClimb(true); return; }
  p.onGround = false;
  sunPlatforms.forEach(pl => {
    if (pl.isSun) return;
    if (p.vy >= 0 && p.y + p.h / 2 >= pl.y && p.y + p.h / 2 <= pl.y + pl.h + p.vy + 2 &&
        p.x + p.w / 2 > pl.x && p.x - p.w / 2 < pl.x + pl.width) {
      p.y = pl.y - p.h / 2;
      p.vy = 0;
      p.onGround = true;
    }
  });
  const playerScreenY = p.y - sunCamY;
  if (playerScreenY > sunCanvas.height + 40) {
    sunLives--;
    updateSunHud();
    if (sunLives <= 0) { endSunClimb(false); return; }
    const sp = sunPlatforms.find(p => p.isStart) || sunPlatforms.filter(p => !p.isSun).reduce((a, b) => (a.y > b.y ? a : b));
    sunStartPlat = sp;
    p.x = sp.x + sp.width / 2;
    p.y = sp.y - 14;
    p.vy = 0;
    sunCamY = sunBottomCamY(sp, sunCanvas.height);
  }
  const bottomCam = sunBottomCamY(sunStartPlat, sunCanvas.height);
  const sunPlat = sunPlatforms.find(pl => pl.isSun);
  const sunCy = sunPlat ? (sunPlat.sunCy || sunPlat.y) : SUN_CENTER_Y;
  const maxCamY = Math.max(0, sunCy + SUN_BODY_RADIUS + SUN_RAY_LEN + 56 - sunCanvas.height);
  const followCam = Math.max(0, p.y - sunCanvas.height * 0.52);
  const stillNearStart = p.y > sunCanvas.height * 0.62;
  const nearSun = p.y < sunCy + SUN_BODY_RADIUS + 100;
  let targetCam;

    targetCam = bottomCam;
  } else if (nearSun) {
    targetCam = Math.max(bottomCam, Math.min(maxCamY, p.y - sunCanvas.height * 0.58));
  } else {
    targetCam = Math.max(bottomCam, followCam);
  }
  targetCam = Math.min(targetCam, maxCamY);
  sunCamY += (targetCam - sunCamY) * 0.15;
  sunHeight = Math.max(sunHeight, Math.floor(-sunCamY / 8));
  if (Math.random() < 0.007) sunFlares.push({ x: Math.random() * sunCanvas.width, y: sunCamY + 60 + Math.random() * 120, w: 32, h: 10, vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4 });
  sunFlares.forEach(f => { f.x += f.vx; });
  sunFlares = sunFlares.filter(f => f.x > -50 && f.x < sunCanvas.width + 50);
  sunFlares.forEach(f => {
    if (Math.abs(p.x - f.x) < 24 && Math.abs(p.y - f.y) < 16) {
      sunLives--;
      updateSunHud();
      f.x = -9999;
      if (sunLives <= 0) { endSunClimb(false); return; }
    }

  sunAnimId = requestAnimationFrame(sunLoop);
}

function drawSunClimb() {
  const c = sunCtx, W = sunCanvas.width, H = sunCanvas.height;
  const bg = c.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, H);
  bg.addColorStop(0, '#1a0800'); bg.addColorStop(1, '#0f0c29');
  c.fillStyle = bg; c.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {

    c.beginPath(); c.arc((i * 97) % W, ((i * 61) % H + sunCamY * 0.1) % H, 1, 0, Math.PI * 2); c.fill();
  }
  sunPlatforms.forEach(pl => {
    const py = pl.y - sunCamY;
    if (py < -30 || py > H + 30) return;
    if (pl.isSun) {
      const cx = pl.sunCx || (pl.x + pl.width / 2);
      const sunR = pl.sunR || SUN_BODY_RADIUS;
      const grd = c.createRadialGradient(cx, py, 5, cx, py, sunR + 5);
      grd.addColorStop(0, '#fff176'); grd.addColorStop(1, '#ff8c00');
      c.fillStyle = grd;
      c.beginPath(); c.arc(cx, py, sunR, 0, Math.PI * 2); c.fill();
      c.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,230,120,0.9)';
      c.lineWidth = 4;
      c.lineCap = 'round';
      for (let i = 0; i < 12; i++) {
        const a = (i / 12) * Math.PI * 2 - Math.PI / 2;
        c.beginPath();
        c.moveTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (sunR - 2), py + Math.sin(a) * (sunR - 2));
        c.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a) * (sunR + SUN_RAY_LEN), py + Math.sin(a) * (sunR + SUN_RAY_LEN));
        c.stroke();
      }
      c.font = '36px serif'; c.textAlign = 'center'; c.fillText('☀️', cx, py + 12);
    } else {
      c.fillStyle = '#ff9800';
      c.fillRect(pl.x, py, pl.width, pl.h);
      c.fillStyle = '#ffd54f';
      c.fillRect(pl.x + 4, py + 3, pl.width - 8, pl.h - 6);
    }
  });
  sunFlares.forEach(f => {
    const fy = f.y - sunCamY;
    c.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,100,0,0.85)';
    c.beginPath(); c.ellipse(f.x, fy, f.w / 2, f.h / 2, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2); c.fill();
  });
  const py = sunPlayer.y - sunCamY;
  c.font = '26px serif'; c.textAlign = 'center'; c.textBaseline = 'middle';
  c.fillText('🧑‍🚀', sunPlayer.x, py);
}

      this.g = document.getElementById('planetGroup');
      this.info = document.getElementById('planetInfo');
      if (!this.svg || !this.g || !this.info) return;
      const S = this;
      S.zoom = defaultPlanetZoom(this.svg, planetType);
const btnSpin = document.getElementById('btnSpin');
      btnSpin.onclick = () => {
        S.spin = !S.spin;
        btnSpin.textContent = S.spin ? 'Stop' : 'Spin';
        btnSpin.classList.toggle('active', !S.spin);
      };
      btnSpin.textContent = 'Stop';
      document.getElementById('btnZoomIn').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.min(2.2, S.zoom + 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnZoomOut').onclick = () => { S.zoom = Math.max(0.55, S.zoom - 0.15); };
      document.getElementById('btnRotL').onclick = () => { S.rot -= 18; };
      document.getElementById('btnRotR').onclick = () => { S.rot += 18; };
      const onDown = e => {
        S.dragging = true;
        S.dragMoved = false;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        S.startX = S.lx = p.clientX;
        S.startY = p.clientY;
      };
      const onMove = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.touches ? e.touches[0] : e;
        if (Math.hypot(p.clientX - S.startX, p.clientY - S.startY) > 12) S.dragMoved = true;
        if (S.dragging) { S.drag += (p.clientX - S.lx) * 0.35; S.lx = p.clientX; }
      };
      const onUp = e => {
        if (!S.dragging) return;
        const p = e.changedTouches ? e.changedTouches[0] : e;
        if (!S.dragMoved && p && S.hitPlanet(p.clientX, p.clientY)) S.nextFact();
        if (S.dragging) { S.rot += S.drag; S.drag = 0; S.dragging = false; }
      };
      this.svg.addEventListener('mousedown', onDown);
      window.addEventListener('mousemove', onMove);
      window.addEventListener('mouseup', onUp);
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { onDown(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchmove', e => { onMove(e); }, { passive: true });
      this.svg.addEventListener('touchend', onUp);
      const loop = () => { if (S.spin) S.ang += 0.012; S.draw(); requestAnimationFrame(loop); };
      this.draw();
      loop();
    },
    hitPlanet(clientX, clientY) {
      const pt = this.svg.createSVGPoint();
      pt.x = clientX;
      pt.y = clientY;
      const m = this.g.getScreenCTM();
      if (!m) return false;
      const p = pt.matrixTransform(m.inverse());
      return p.x * p.x + p.y * p.y <= 88 * 88;
    },
    nextFact() {
      this.fi = (this.fi + 1) % this.facts.length;
      this.info.innerHTML = '<strong>' + label + '</strong><br>' + this.facts[this.fi];
    },
    draw() {
      while (this.g.firstChild) this.g.removeChild(this.g.firstChild);
      this.g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(200,200) rotate(' + (this.rot + this.drag) + ') scale(' + this.zoom + ') rotate(' + this.ang + ')');
      StylizedPlanet.draw(this.g, planetType, 88);
    }
  };
}

const PlanetViewer = makePlanetViewer('sun', sunFacts, '☀️ The Sun');
try { PlanetViewer.init(); } catch (err) { console.error('Planet viewer:', err); }

</script>
</body>
</html>

steps.title: The Sun Explained
steps.contentHtml:
📚 The Sun Explained

Learn more about our amazing star!

⚛️ What is the Sun Made Of?

The Sun is made mostly of two gases: hydrogen (about 73%) and helium (about 25%). The remaining 2% is made of other elements like oxygen, carbon, and iron.

The Sun creates energy by turning hydrogen into helium in a process called nuclear fusion. This happens in the Sun's core, where it's super hot!

💡 Fun Fact

The Sun uses 600 million tons of hydrogen every second!

🔥 Parts of the Sun

The Sun has different layers, just like Earth has layers:

  • Core - The hottest part where energy is made
  • Radiative Zone - Energy moves through this layer
  • Convective Zone - Hot gas rises and cools gas falls
  • Photosphere - The visible surface we see
  • Corona - The outer atmosphere, super hot!

🌡️ Solar Activity

The Sun is very active! It has things called:

  • Sunspots - Darker, cooler areas on the surface
  • Solar Flares - Big bursts of energy and light
  • Coronal Mass Ejections - Huge clouds of gas that fly into space

Sometimes these can affect Earth! They might cause beautiful auroras (northern lights) or even mess with satellites and power grids.

🌅 Day and Night

Earth rotates (spins) on its axis once every 24 hours. This is why we have day and night. When part of Earth faces the Sun, it's daytime. When it faces away, it's nighttime.

The Sun always rises in the east and sets in the west because of Earth's rotation!

💡 Fun Fact

The Sun is actually a star, just like the stars you see at night - it's just much closer to us!

🔭 The Sun's Future

The Sun has been shining for about 4.6 billion years and will continue for about 5 billion more years. Eventually, it will run out of hydrogen and become a red giant, then a white dwarf.

But don't worry - that won't happen for a very, very long time!

🛡️ Staying Safe

The Sun gives us life, but we need to be careful too:

  • Never look directly at the Sun - it can hurt your eyes!
  • Wear sunscreen to protect your skin from UV rays
  • Wear sunglasses on bright days
  • Stay in the shade during the hottest part of the day
